1049590.short_description: Eternal Return is a free-to-play, 2.5D perspective Battle Royale game. Search, Craft, Hunt, and Fight using a variety of characters. Plan your strategy and become the last survivor on this eternal experiment.

1066890.name: Automobilista 2
1066890.short_description: Automobilista 2 is all the racing simulators you ever wanted - in just one. An incredibly diverse collection of cars and tracks cohesively simulated, featuring incredible graphics and audio quality, dynamic weather and track conditions and the best VR support for a racing experience like no other.

1139980.name: Travellers Rest
1139980.short_description: Craft, farm, build and cook! In Travellers Rest you will have to use all the available tools to become the best tavern keeper in the realm. Create unique dishes and drinks to please your customers as you discover the world and its colorful characters.

1256670.name: Library Of Ruina
1256670.short_description: "May you find your book in this place." Combat between the guests and the librarians breaks out as if it were on a stage. Defeated guests turn into books, and the Library grows onward. And eventually, get your hands on… The one singular, perfect book.

1274570.name: DEVOUR
1274570.short_description: DEVOUR is a co-op horror survival game for 1-4 players. Stop possessed cultists before they drag you to hell. Run. Scream. Hide. Just don't get caught.

1859910.name: Legend of Mortal
1859910.short_description: The game world is set in a turbulent state and the mighty Tang-Man declines. The threats from the old enemies keep coming one after another.As a nobody, will you choose either to leave yourself out of it or to fight for Tang-Man's future and turning the tide? The journey of yours,is unpredictable.

1948280.name: Stacklands
1948280.short_description: Stacklands is a village builder where you stack cards to collect food, build structures, and fight creatures. 🃏 For example, dragging a Villager card on top of a Berry Bush card will spawn Berry cards which the villagers can eat to survive. 🃏 Play your cards right and expand your village!

2273430.name: BlazBlue Entropy Effect
2273430.short_description: Enjoy action-packed flashy combat with incredibly satisfying combos and responsive controls! Numerous characters, each with completely unique playstyles and loads of unlockable moves & upgrades! This action roguelike sets the bar for fluid fast-paced action.

2445690.name: Lost Castle 2
2445690.short_description: "Lost Castle 2" is a 2D Beat'em up Rogue-Lite game. Explore abundant treasures and items to enhance yourself, master various weapons to showcase your skills, and challenge powerful monsters to demonstrate your strength. A new adventure is calling for treasure hunters!

2622000.name: Astral Party
2622000.short_description: Astral Party is a multiplayer party game populated by cute anime girls! Choose your favorite character, strategize skills & cards, and roll the dice to destroy friendships in this unique board game.

2634950.name: Tokyo Xtreme Racer
2634950.short_description: The title of “fastest” never fades. Race through the sealed future Tokyo night highways in your customized car. Defeat rivals in “SP Battle,” where drivers clash by draining Spirit Points. A unique racing game where only the rules for victory matter.

2696050.name: Yarimono
2696050.short_description: The protagonist's life takes a turn after their partner Yarimon learns the ultra-invincible move, the "Cheat Tackle". While challenging various trainers to participate in the Yarimon tournament, the protagonist unexpectedly discovers the secrets of this world.

2712460.name: DUNGEON SLASHER
2712460.short_description: Navigate maps filled with enemies, destroying all who get in your way! Use a variety of character, artifact, and skill synergies to defeat the dungeon!

2725250.name: Nientum - Op.ZERO
2725250.short_description: A 2D action-adventure where the story unfolds by tuning the stage with music. A play by Aleph and Liora, who have lost their memories. A beautiful yet eerie stage, and the secret of the forgotten theater await. Your choices will determine the play's ending — and their fates.

2737070.name: Crime Simulator
2737070.short_description: You’re out of jail, but the debt isn’t gone. Sneak, steal, and break into houses solo or in 4-player co-op. Use lockpicks, sleeping gas, and brute force to complete jobs, outsmart security, and make enough money before time runs out. Will you pay back what you owe, or lose everything?

2827200.name: MIMESIS
2827200.short_description: A 4-player online co-op survival horror game. Avoid the contaminated rain, gather scrap and get back to the tram. Monsters that copy your friends' voices and behavior, and many other threats, stand in your way. Gear up and stick together to survive.

3101040.name: Magical Girl Witch Trials
3101040.short_description: Thirteen girls awaken, only to find themselves in a prison. What awaits them: a Witch Trial. Help them prepare for the trial by exploring the prison in order to find the witch hidden amongst them. Find the witch, learn what kind of magic she holds, dispel the lies, and prepare for the execution.

3208930.name: Galvatein : Adventurers' Guild
3208930.short_description: "Welcome, adventurer! What quest have you completed today?” A classic fantasy guild reception simulation — 『Galvatein: Adventurer’s Guild』

3299050.name: No Such Place
3299050.short_description: Welcome to the Unknown Research Consortium (U.R.C.), where you’re tasked with conducting reconnaissance missions, terminating unknown threats, gathering crucial information, and reaching the evacuation point in this treacherous top-down extraction shooter.

3314790.name: CloverPit
3314790.short_description: A rogue-lite slot machine nightmare. Gamble for your life in a never-ending debt simulator!

3971950.name: In Falsus
3971950.short_description: In a world bound by truths: connect. In Falsus is a mesmerizing rhythm game tied to an intricate card system brought together through a layered narrative. Taking place in a near-future world, traverse an atmospheric soundscape through the eyes of 5 interconnected protagonists.

4148240.name: Road to Empress Ⅱ
4148240.short_description: Play as the protagonist in this live-action interactive palace survival drama! Take a dynasty's fate into your own hands in Road to Empress II, the new content of the global hit. Defy fate, navigate intrigue, and claim the throne of power. You decide it all!

4259190.name: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD
4259190.short_description: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis is a fantasy tower defense strategy game that takes you back in time to the early days of the Kingdom with bold new twists. Build towers, command heroes, and stop Vez’nan’s corruption before it tears the kingdom apart!

4559140.name: Godius Eternal War
4559140.short_description: A classic 2D pixel MMORPG inspired by the golden age of online RPGs. Join nation wars, explore an open multiplayer world, trade with players, battle in PvP, and experience a community-driven adventure that has continued since 1999.

4771580.name: Five Nights with Maids
4771580.short_description: In this survival horror game, play as a night guard watching over a mansion and its maids for five nights. Use lights, shutters, and cameras to spot suspicious activity. Each night grows more intense as the atmosphere shifts and the maids begin to behave strangely. Can you survive till the end?

4800590.name: Supermarket Chaos
4800590.short_description: Supermarket Chaos is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort 4,668 products in a messy supermarket. Enjoy the satisfaction of stocking shelves in a calm, relaxing atmosphere.

5020310.name: Dub Together
5020310.short_description: Up to eight players redub video clips and give them a whole new meaning. You record the scene, then watch every result together and vote. With voice effects, a built-in clip editor and live voting from your Twitch chat.

5044770.name: The Death Game Report
5044770.short_description: Identify how every participant in the death game died, and submit your report.

5245810.name: ForgeTax
5245810.short_description: A dark, first-person forging roguelite. Hammer swords into absurd fortunes, bend the odds with relics, and risk it all on your next strike. Spend precious blades to build powerful synergies. Meet the dragon's tribute—or face its wrath.

858820.name: Tribes of Midgard
858820.short_description: A vibrant blend of survival and action RPG for 1-10 players! Craft legendary items, grow your home base and embark on an epic journey through procedural realms to face towering creatures hel-bent on unleashing Ragnarök. Valhalla can wait, Einherjar!

868360.name: Project Hospital
868360.short_description: Become an ace doctor, an aspiring architect and a successful manager at the same time. Design your very own hospital, tweak every detail or choose one of the prebuilt scenarios and just jump to the doctor’s duty.

1272160.name: The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante
1272160.short_description: A narrative-driven hardcore RPG set in a gritty world ruled by real but unrelenting gods. Set out on a challenging lifetime journey, where every choice has a price and entails consequences. Will you become an inquisitor, a judge, or conspire against the old order? Dare to decide!

1385380.name: Across the Obelisk
1385380.short_description: Set forth in a co-op roguelite deckbuilder where every choice matters! Craft decks of breathtaking power. Journey alone or with up to three friends. Plot your party’s path to glory and face powerful enemies in deep tactical combat on your quest to save the kingdom of Senenthia in Across the Obelisk!

1568590.name: Goose Goose Duck
1568590.short_description: Goose Goose Duck is a game of social deduction for up to 16 players. Players are separated into different groups that are each assigned a different objective. Complete your team’s objective to win!

1682970.name: Uncrashed : FPV Drone Simulator
1682970.short_description: Amateur or experienced FPV pilot, learn or improve your skills on Uncrashed, the ultra realistic FPV simulator. Simulate your own FPV drone with settings based on real values and you will have the same feeling as a real flight without the risk of breaking your drone!

1911610.name: Windblown
1911610.short_description: A lightning-fast 1–3 player co-op roguelite from the creators of Dead Cells. DASH, DIVE and DESTROY across a shattered world. Build wild loadouts, unleash devastating Alterattacks, and become the last stand against the Vortex.

1946560.name: sobosuba
1946560.short_description: sobosuba is a merge game with ultra-squishy soft-body physics. Satisfying and relaxing -but strategy, tricks, and skill matter for chasing high scores.

2069070.name: Hay! One Billion!
2069070.short_description: You dropped your favorite needle... in a barn with exactly One Billion pieces of hay. Guess you better go find the needle in a haystack. Search around with your hands, find coins to purchase tools and search faster, and eventually reclaim your lost needle.

2289750.name: Super Fantasy Kingdom
2289750.short_description: Rebuild your kingdom and explore a vibrant fantasy world in this roguelite city builder. Defeat hordes of monsters with a unique team of defenders as you harvest, build, mine, cook, brew, and grow. But if your defenses should fail, be prepared to watch it all burn!

2390230.name: The Chef's Shift
2390230.short_description: The Chef’s Shift is a fast-paced typing game in a restaurant setting, where you’ll both cook & serve food to hungry customers, all done by TYPING.

2421750.name: Gunman Contracts - Stand Alone
2421750.short_description: "Gunman Contracts - Stand Alone" is an intense, action-movie inspired single player shooter created for VR and Non-VR. As a professional hitman, take on ruthless forces in the criminal underworld - one contract at a time.

2445430.name: Tensei Brave
2445430.short_description: Due to the invasion of the Demon Lord, countries around the world have been destroyed. In the last remaining country, a hero is summoned. Players control the hero, gather allies, and set out on a journey to defeat the Demon Lord. Can the seemingly weak protagonist indeed vanquish the Demon Lord?

2763740.name: Revolution Idle
2763740.short_description: Revolution Idle is a free idle incremental game with offline progress, prestige layers, and endless automation. Start simple, reach infinity and go further.

2914150.name: Yunyun Syndrome!? Rhythm Psychosis
2914150.short_description: “Yunyun Syndrome!? Rhythm Psychosis” is a rhythm adventure game about a psychotic hikikomori girl - also an avid anonymous poster - who corrupts the world with her severe brain rot from listening to too many denpa songs. Yunyun all over this ♡♡♡♡ world with your degen otaku-posting.

2939510.name: Under Canopies
2939510.short_description: Forget the stress of survival. In this cozy open-world sim, you don't fight nature, you join it. Build your dream cabin piece by piece, cook complex meals with crops you watered yourself, and fill your photo album with rare wildlife. A serene experience where the only enemy is inefficiency.

3103780.name: DRAPLINE
3103780.short_description: "DRAPLINE" is a roguelite training game where you raise a dragon girl who eats anything and train her to become the strongest in one year. Feed her a variety of things to increase her abilities, combine various skills to build your own strategy, and defeat the impending catastrophe!

3375110.name: Tiny Eden
3375110.short_description: A cozy first-person farming sim, set in the heart of a futuristic city. Grow plants, cook what you harvest, and discover new varieties as you turn your apartment into a thriving urban garden, from a small balcony to a rooftop paradise.

3390460.name: Kitchen Traitor
3390460.short_description: Cook together. Question everyone. Kitchen Traitor is a first-person cooking and social deduction game for 4–8 players online. Chop, cook and serve across three restaurants while hidden traitors turn mistakes into sabotage. Call a meeting, choose who to trust and keep the restaurant open.

3954920.name: Saving Songburg™
3954920.short_description: Saving Songburg™ is a 3D third-person action-adventure platformer, set in a whimsical Steampunk world. Help the robot Automavoz save the town of Songburg from the interdimensional gang of art thieves known as the Dream Stealers!

4073100.name: Dreadnut
4073100.short_description: A horror game about the night shift at a donut shop. To help pay for your sister's treatment, you take seven nights behind the counter. Fry, glaze and box the orders, and serve the customer who comes in after closing and knows far too much about you.

4100790.name: Echoes of Pinebridge
4100790.short_description: After a transfer student enters his life, college senior Kent begins suffering fainting spells and hearing voices. Navigate friendships, secrets, and a growing supernatural mystery in this choice-driven visual novel.

4119420.name: Evitania Online - Idle RPG
4119420.short_description: Online Idle RPG with an open world without the grind of classic MMORPGs. Collect rare loot, develop your character, master professions, craft powerful gear, and defeat challenging bosses as you progress endlessly.

4348240.name: Ashen Knight
4348240.short_description: A dark fantasy survivor roguelike with automatic combat, where every run starts from nothing. Unlock unique heroes, experiment with powerful skill builds, and survive relentless enemy waves.

4348500.name: Furniture Restoration Simulator: Garage Edition - Prologue
4348500.short_description: Turn old, damaged furniture into beautiful pieces again. Sand, paint, polish, and enjoy the relaxing process of restoration. Play the free Prologue and experience the first steps of your renovation workshop.

4560660.name: Eslabong
4560660.short_description: Arena combat meets mercenary club management. Recruit from a dynamic market, build your squad, and compete season after season in leagues and cups.

4715430.name: River Secret
4715430.short_description: A story about a beautiful river that hides deadly secrets beneath its calm surface.

4764890.name: +PROTECTUS-
4764890.short_description: 🧲 A minimalist first‑person puzzle game where you have to escape from a ruined lunar complex using an experimental magnetic cannon and uncover the secrets of the ECHO project together with the drone Kruitni.

4800650.name: 7 Millimeters
4800650.short_description: Start your journey as a carpenter in a new neighborhood. Take measurements, install furniture and fulfill customer orders. But success attracts trouble; a local gang demands a fee. Refuse, turn your shop into a fortress, and arm yourself to defend your life. will you pay or resist?

4924290.name: Fire Bug
4924290.short_description: Hold the sun in your hand in this fast-paced arcade game. Play as a magnifying glass and cook swarms of bugs before time runs out. Chain ignitions, defeat tier bosses, and spend your Sparks on upgrades tree to unlock explosive criticals, burn trails, and smoldering spore clouds.

4924750.name: Village of the Mirror
4924750.short_description: A first-person psychological horror set in a forgotten village where Japanese and Anatolian folklore collide. Explore abandoned places, solve puzzles, uncover the past, and cross Torii gates into the afterlife to uncover the truth.

4956380.name: The Lighthouse Restaurant
4956380.short_description: The Lighthouse Restaurant is a first-person psychological horror game set in a unique dining spot. Listen to your guests' stories, decide what they eat, shape their fates, and unearth the truth behind your own story.

4984610.name: Hazard Crew
4984610.short_description: A first-person bodycam horror game, 1-4 player co-op about scavenging. Explore a procedurally generated maze of empty rooms for Hazard Recovery Co., collecting objects graded on rarity. Every corridor is a choice: leave with something ordinary, or go deeper in the dark for something worth more.

5169220.name: Campsite
5169220.short_description: Warm nights in the evergreen forest, the peace and quiet, the gentle flicker of fire. Too quiet, almost unnatural. Something sinister lurks in the dark. It's faster than you, it's smarter than you, and it wants you out of it's forest. Your only hope to keep the flames from hollowing. Good luck.

5169900.name: DODGE GAME
5169900.short_description: Dodge relentless enemy swarms, build score-multiplying combos, and unleash devastating powers in a fast-paced arcade survival game. Conquer evolving arenas, defeat intense bosses, and climb the leaderboards.

5188640.name: Pancake! No break!
5188640.short_description: An incremental cooking game where you wake up on mysterious cloud islands and have to cook pancakes to find a way out.

5196710.name: Paper and Pencil
5196710.short_description: A cosy newspaper of puzzles. Eighteen columns — sudoku, crosswords, nonograms, mazes and more — printed fresh every day, solved over a pixel-art coffee. Ten columns free forever; the Sunday Edition adds eight deeper puzzles. Fully offline, endless extras, and every puzzle has exactly one solution.

5196790.name: Coffee Keeper
5196790.short_description: Sort 4,179 scattered bags, tins, bottles, brewing gear, pastries and more throughout a two-storey coffee house. Match every piece to its proper place, unlock helpful skills, and restore perfect order at your own pace—or race the clock.

5199510.name: Undervein
5199510.short_description: Deep under the mountain there is a seam that never runs dry, a crew of dwarves who will mine it while you sleep, and a door covered in runes that nobody has opened. Click. Build. Descend. And be ready when the mountain's wrath wakes.

5251070.name: Want a Bomb?
5251070.short_description: Explore an island in search of the Sun Gem, solo or with up to 4 players online. Blast through mountains, sell ore, research and upgrade your gear, and take on monsters. From chain reactions to launchers that send friends flying, carve your own path!

5254400.name: SND
5254400.short_description: You are hiding in a locker. Don't panic... It passes in front of you. You stay hidden. Its footsteps fade. Should you get out now, or will it come back? You're trapped in a facility plunged into pitch-black darkness. You can hear it. You can hide from it but you can't kill it...

5272490.name: Catch The Ducks
5272490.short_description: Catch The Ducks is a colorful online party game where ducks and farmers clash across chaotic arenas. Chase, escape, paint and customize your character, then compete in Classic, Battle, Free Fall, Hot Potato and Infection modes.

5284710.name: SHAME
5284710.short_description: SHAME, A Survival Horror Game, Where Player must survive through the night against vampire like creatures. Gear up with the vast amount of weapons to slay these beast, shop for ammo and resources , and try your best to survive through the night.

5292740.name: Raze the Zombie Horde
5292740.short_description: A single-player top-down zombie shooter across streets, fortresses, beaches and infected facilities. Adapt to two-sided run cards or build up to eight guns firing at once in Loot Arsenal. Develop four heroes and bring a tank, collie or robot dog on standard operations.

5300960.name: KEEP IT ON HER
5300960.short_description: A first-person horror game at Sweetie's Motel, solo or in online co-op with up to 3 friends. Bring the guests forty towels and mop up after them. At nightfall the power cuts out and the front doors lock. When the lights come back, Sweetie is on the hunt.

5317740.name: Something in the Rows
5317740.short_description: Something is moving through the corn. Explore Halloway Farms alone or with up to three friends online, recover eight wards, mend the broken ones in the Halloway mansion and escape before the Gleaner finds you. It listens for your footsteps and your voice, and it may even look like your friend.

5319430.name: Gen'ei ninja
5319430.short_description: Punch, leap and wall-jump through a retro side-scrolling action platformer. Battle through twelve areas and five bosses, collect weapons, and learn when to evade or strike. Gen'ei ninja combines platforming with close-range combat and old-school challenge.

5322590.name: Railwright
5322590.short_description: Design and build your own rail vehicles, lay the tracks they run on, drive your creations, haul cargo, and develop new technology in an open-ended railway engineering sandbox.

5342920.name: SpellWeave
5342920.short_description: Build a wand out of spell cards that modify and combine with each other, then fight down through an endless dungeon. Order is everything: a modifier changes every spell after it. No final floor — the run ends when you do.

5353860.name: Magehold Fairwinds
5353860.short_description: Crew a leaking airship across five acts of painted sky. Route Flow, raise wind shields, cast from the Casting Room and board your enemies in real-time-with-pause battles, then pay off the debt, if you can. An airship roguelite set in the world of Magehold.

5358580.name: Give Us Back Gravity
5358580.short_description: A zero-gravity push-your-luck roguelite about salvaging a derelict space station. There are no brakes: thrusters burn oxygen, so you stop by kicking off walls or throwing cargo the other way. Take all you can carry, but it only pays if you get it back to the airlock. Online co-op for up to 4.

5364900.name: ABAX
5364900.short_description: A Classic Board Game Experience , Original Game design and mechanics should be engaging and challenging even for the most experienced board game enthusiast. Utilizing a Dice Roll Mechanic for all actions so even the most well planned strategy may fall apart.

5371210.name: Little Angler
5371210.short_description: Little Angler is a cozy fishing game that lives on your desktop. Catch dozens of creatures, complete your album, explore new regions, earn coins, unlock upgrades, and customize your angler with characters, islands, bobbers, rods, vests, and more.

5377190.name: Halloweenies Candy Run
5377190.short_description: Trick-or-treat with up to 4 players. Loot the houses on procedurally generated streets. Find rare physics based candy and bank it before the Candy KPI catches up with you. Buy weapons and abilities to help your odds against the horde. Your friends can hear proximity chat, but so can the hunters.

5380730.name: Pocket Sports
5380730.short_description: Grab a friend and split one handheld down the middle. Air hockey, bowling, sumo and Turf Wars for two: each player holds one side, or play online with a Steam friend.

5380860.name: Last House Standing
5380860.short_description: One house, a lab inside, and thousands of zombies outside. Hold out for 25 waves while Dr. Ferrán finishes the cure. Every run earns coins for the upgrade tree: barbed wire, bear traps, mines, a mortar on the roof and, if you make it that far, an airstrike.

5385830.name: Lily or Horse
5385830.short_description: The easiest game in the world. Flip a coin and call it: lily or horse? Call it right 10 times in a row to win. Miss, and the coins you bet are thrown away. With a little luck, it only takes 10 flips.

5393420.name: Elya
5393420.short_description: Raise a desktop companion in a cozy single-player pet game. Chat, build your bond, collect memories, and customize her with characters, skins, animations, and Workshop creations.

5398190.name: Fish with Friends
5398190.short_description: A co-op fishing game for 1 to 4 players. Catch fish, sell your haul and buy better rods and bigger boats. Head further out for bigger catches, but keep an eye on the weight. Every fish goes in the boat, and too many will sink it.

219740.name: Don't Starve
219740.short_description: Don’t Starve is an uncompromising wilderness survival game full of science and magic. Enter a strange and unexplored world full of strange creatures, dangers, and surprises. Gather resources to craft items and structures that match your survival style.

314650.name: SpaceEngine
314650.short_description: The world's first science-based photorealistic interactive 3D planetarium that models the entire Universe, using procedural generation for uncharted areas.

743450.name: Monster Prom
743450.short_description: You have 3 weeks to get a date for Monster Prom! Go through absurd and funny situations, raise your stats and seduce one of your classmates. Beautiful art, bold, unapologetic dialogue and hard choices make up this Multiplayer (1-4 players) Dating Sim. Be your worst self.

860510.name: Little Nightmares II
860510.short_description: Little Nightmares II is the second game in a series that has thrilled and captivated millions of players worldwide since 2017. Now it’s your turn to try to survive this critically acclaimed entry in the most charming horror series ever made.

1016920.name: Unrailed!
1016920.short_description: Unrailed! is a co-op multiplayer game where you have to work together with your friends to build a train track across endless procedurally generated worlds. Master random encounters with its inhabitants, upgrade your train and keep it from derailing!

1062520.name: Dinkum
1062520.short_description: Dinkum is a survival life simulation game set on an island inspired by the rugged Australian outback. Farm, hunt, mine, fish, and forage to gather resources, expand your town, and discover what makes Dinkum so special—either solo or with friends.

1140270.name: Monster Prom 2: Monster Camp
1140270.short_description: "Monster Prom 2: Monster Camp" brings you more of the world's best (and maybe only?) multiplayer dating sim; but in a way you've never expected!

1353300.name: Idle Slayer
1353300.short_description: Start from nothing and grow into a legendary Slayer. Explore countless dimensions, collect souls, unlock powerful upgrades, craft powerful gear, defeat epic bosses, and enjoy a deep idle RPG with active and offline progression.

1407560.name: Hot Mic
1407560.short_description: Your friends have heard your Roman emperor a hundred times. Nobody's ready for your cockerel.🐔 Hot Mic is an online party game played with your voice, for 2 to 8 players. Set your mic ablaze!🔥

1446140.name: Spook & Sell
1446140.short_description: Stage the haunt. Sell the house. You’re the world’s most desperate real-estate agents — hide the ghosts, mop the ectoplasm, and keep buyers calm in this chaotic 1–4 player co-op physics party game before the haunting meter tips over.

1665190.name: Monster Prom 3: Monster Roadtrip
1665190.short_description: Embark on a road trip like no other in this co-op narrative survival adventure. Visit fun locations, meet wacky characters, and manage your resources wisely. And yes: you still can date some hot monsters ;)

1677740.name: Stumble Guys
1677740.short_description: Ready for the chaos? Stumble Guys is a 32-player, fast-paced multiplayer party royale where players dash, jump, and fall across hilarious obstacle courses in a fun race to be the last one standing.

2430710.name: Operator: Observation
2430710.short_description: Take on the role of Colin Nox, a security operator monitoring surveillance cameras for anomalies. What starts as a routine job quickly turns sinister as the anomalies grow more aggressive, invading the houses you watch, breaking into your home, and crawling into your mind.

2445260.name: Tyr
2445260.short_description: Tyr is a multiplayer tank shooter. Pilot heavy-armored vehicles with unique capabilities and upgrade them as you battle for victory with your team.

2551970.name: Outcast Tales
2551970.short_description: A challenging post-apocalyptic roguelite turn-based RPG about the psychological stresses of adventuring with complete idiots. Lead a crew of flawed heroes against the consequences of their own terrible decisions. Can you keep your heroes together when everyone thinks they're in charge?

2869860.name: Monster Prom 4: Monster Con
2869860.short_description: Can you find love at the nerdiest convention ever? "Monster Con" goes back to the multiplayer dating sim formula: go through absurd and funny situations as you find love among six sexy monsters! Who will you romance? The mimic who cosplays? The idol clown? Or the eldritch cutie? (There's also Liam)

3198850.name: Play Together
3198850.short_description: Play Together is a popular casual social networking game enjoyed by players worldwide. Express yourself through character customization, decorate your home and host Home Parties for a fun time with friends. Enjoy tons of content with friends from all across the globe!

3460540.name: Cardtographer
3460540.short_description: Evil has returned! Complete the card collection to seal it away! Build synergistic decks for tactical battles. Survive procedurally generated roguelike runs—solo or in co-op—with danger lurking around every corner. Carve your path and become the cardtographer!

3617620.name: My Card Is Better Than Your Card!
3617620.short_description: Become the coolest kid of the playground in this playful roguelike deckbuilder. Craft every card yourself with adorable stickers and wow your rivals in tug-of-war card battles full of wonder!

3678970.name: TBH: Task Bar Hero
3678970.short_description: The ultimate tiny idle RPG! Adorable pixel heroes are waiting to join your adventure — from your taskbar. Fight off the boredom of work and daily life with diverse classes, skills, items, and builds!

3721020.name: Galactic Bounty
3721020.short_description: Play as a droid bounty hunter for hire. Accept contracts, deploy into dangerous locations, eliminate targets, break into secure systems, and get paid. Spend your rewards on weapons, gear and software upgrades for your droid.

3866090.name: Flipping Phantom
3866090.short_description: A puzzle platformer where you can’t jump?! Phase into the ground and flip upside-down to find your way around this spooky playground!

4236650.name: Adultery Marriage Punisher
4236650.short_description: "Adultery Marriage Punisher" Curing marriage pests! Investigate. Infiltrate. Snap. Spy. Steal. Outwit. What is your spouse doing behind your back? Your evidence, the deadliest sanction. Now, become the shadow of justice, and unveil every betrayal and infidelity!

4439360.name: Chain of Command
4439360.short_description: Chain of Command is a top-down arena shooter roguelike, where you control a snake-like chain of fighters that attack automatically. Choose your Commander and build your party to create high-synergy builds to crush the invading demon armies.

4719390.name: Change
4719390.short_description: Atmospheric simulator of the seller in a night stall of the 1993 model. Immerse yourself in the melancholy of the sleeping area: sell goods, count the change and communicate with customers.

4774030.name: Conquer the Labyrinth
4774030.short_description: Conquer the Labyrinth is an anime-inspired third-person Action RPG where you battle through a 100-floor procedural dungeon filled with deadly monsters, powerful loot, and Epic Bosses guarding every portal to the floor below. Grow stronger through crafting, skill progression, and intense combat.

4780790.name: Tetheg
4780790.short_description: Race to the other side in this original board game! The catch? You can’t let the strings tying the pieces together cross. Test your wits against your friends as you maneuver your pieces, block your opponent, and slip through their defenses in local multiplayer.

4866750.name: A Northern Evil: Tape One
4866750.short_description: A short atmospheric horror experience set in the remote north of Sweden. Explore an abandoned village where something is deeply wrong, uncover strange clues, and face a lurking evil hidden beneath the quiet surface.

4881270.name: Mahjong Rush
4881270.short_description: A single-player mahjong roguelike with an ink-wash art style. Make runs and sets from your tiles to score points — complete a winning hand and your score multiplies. Buy Flower cards, talismans and treasures to get stronger.. Never played mahjong? A step-by-step tutorial gets you started.

4987640.name: TRAPPIST-1
4987640.short_description: A short sci-fi horror game. Extract energy from a red dwarf, tune signals, and power distant worlds. Do your job. Don't ask what really keeps the station running.

5000550.name: Nitro Nonsense
5000550.short_description: A chaotic party racer for 1, 2, 4, 8, or up to 16 players, locally or online! Race in split-screen or share a top-down view, build custom tracks, and fill them with traps and obstacles when you win. If you lose, don’t worry: you get to upgrade your car and come back stronger for the next round!

5005180.name: Checkmate: The Red General’s Last Move
5005180.short_description: Checkmate is a turn-based Xiangqi roguelite where a lone red general carries a cannon into a 9×10 battlefield. Move to reload, fire risky snap shots, aim for precision, and use enemy pieces as firing screens. Each upgrade also strengthens the opposing army.

5027520.name: Megastore: Tidy Up Together
5027520.short_description: Megastore: Tidy Up Together is a cozy sorting game for solo or online co-op play. Organize four stores of increasing scale: a Toy Store, an Electronics Store, a bustling Supermarket, and a massive two-story Megastore. Pick up, sort, and shelve thousands of items, and get ready to open!

5034850.name: Jewel Reels
5034850.short_description: Build a little workshop into a jewel-clearing machine. Pull the reels, set off colorful chain reactions, combine clever accessories, and invest your coins to conquer eight contracts. Keep building after victory or retire to begin again with a lasting Legacy. Play in 13 languages on Windows.

5087180.name: Excids: Endless Siege
5087180.short_description: Defend your castle in a dark fantasy action roguelite. Choose your hero, survive endless enemy waves, unlock relics, skills, and upgrades, to try and finish every level.

5107320.name: WHAT LURKS BELOW
5107320.short_description: First-person hide-and-seek horror. Tag: a catch swaps Hunter and Runner. Hunt: a catch adds a Hunter. New maze each round. Online lobbies or bots, proximity voice.

5131740.name: 单机斗地主
5131740.short_description: 《单机斗地主》是一款专为喜欢经典斗地主玩法的玩家打造的单机休闲棋牌游戏。无需联网，无需匹配其他玩家，随时打开即可开始游戏。游戏采用经典斗地主规则，玩家将与电脑AI对手进行对局，体验叫地主、抢地主、出牌与配合的完整流程。游戏提供多种难度选择，AI对手会根据难度调整出牌策略，让新手可以轻松上手，也能满足熟悉斗地主玩法的玩家挑战更高难度。游戏节奏轻快，操作简单，并支持键盘、鼠标及手柄操作。无复杂养成、无强制社交，专注于纯粹的斗地主乐趣，适合碎片时间游玩，也适合长期休闲体验。

5171280.name: wishbound
5171280.short_description: At 3am, an app called tally installs itself on your phone and starts granting wishes. All of them. A psychological horror story told entirely through a phone screen. 5 nights, 3 routes, 18 endings, some you can only reach by losing on purpose. Every wish is granted. Every wish is owed.

5199280.name: DOOM MATES
5199280.short_description: An online multiplayer horror for up to 5 players. One of you is the hunter, and the rest have to work together to escape strange places. No two runs are the same, because these places always change. Create your own jumpscare and watch your friends run into it in the dark!

5224210.name: Demonfall Continent
developers: Nanjing Shangxiangyujiu Network Technology Co., Ltd.
publishers: Nanjing Shangxiangyujiu Network Technology Co., Ltd.
5224210.short_description: Explore a magic-soaked continent, battle beasts and towering bosses, learn a wide variety of skills, and shape your build with Inner Arts, attributes, and gear. Hunt for loot, cook useful food, reforge affixes, and grow stronger through every expedition in this dark mythic single-player action RPG.

5230130.name: The Consumed
5230130.short_description: Play as a Night-Shift Mall Security Guard in this first-person analog horror game. Check, secure, and attempt to survive the haunted shops in this dying mall.

5248430.name: Picpic
5248430.short_description: Sharp eyes. Fast combos. Fierce rivals. Picpic is an anime-style spot-the-difference PvP game. Find differences before your opponent, rack up combo scores, and attack to disrupt their play. Keep your focus as the clock ticks down!

5265120.name: Lyra Quinn - Black Hole
5265120.short_description: A fast-paced 2D sci-fi arcade shooter. Pilot Lyra through 26 action-packed levels, destroy dangerous space enemies, survive escalating threats, and defeat the final boss in a challenging cosmic adventure.

5278300.name: Adventurer 95
5278300.short_description: A roguelite RPG inside a retro desktop. Choose your route, build your hero with skills, loot and relics, and face bosses in automatic combat. Unlock four classes, invest in permanent upgrades and return for a new run with tougher challenges.

5285750.name: Tilt Rivals
5285750.short_description: Fast-paced pinball meets head-to-head competition. Challenge rivals online, face a friend in local PvP or take on the CPU solo. Defend your goal, unleash power-ups and survive double-ball chaos across unlockable arenas. One more point. One more rematch.

5299880.name: Leikkaus
5299880.short_description: One student, one abandoned university, and someone who is after their benefits... or more. Hide. Run. Don't get cut.

5305770.name: Gimby
5305770.short_description: Guard the Skull and Crown of the dead King of the Underworld. Explore, hunt, fish and build by day, then hold your tower against the horde each night.

5311670.name: The Drowned Table
5311670.short_description: The Drowned Table is a psychological horror dice roguelike where you cast physical 3D dice across a sinking cabin table to appease a demanding entity. Build from over 200 dice and over 100 Curios, keep your Madness in check, descend eight depths to The Abyss, then carry on in Endless Mode.

5325200.name: History Experience: Rome
5325200.short_description: Explore the daily life of historical Rome with an impressive level of detail and realism. Thanks to next-generation graphics, each space has been faithfully recreated, from the classical architecture of a Roman domus to the martial atmosphere of a castrum.

5328810.name: Blockmania
5328810.short_description: A block-puzzle roguelike. Place pieces on an 8×8 board, clear lines and score Chips × Mult. Upgrade your own bag of blocks, collect 92 rule-bending Jokers and beat 12 rounds of bosses, then push into Overtime and try to break the machine.

5332800.name: Halloween 3D
5332800.short_description: A haunted manor, its creatures and nine letters to gather. Explore the levels alone, fight up to four friends online, or build the shared manor with every player: a world made of blocks that everyone reshapes, and that stays.

5347360.name: Memory Access Violation
5347360.short_description: A first-person dream in rectangular prisms. Wander 37 corrupted memories of light and geometry: bend light through prisms, recall platforms that aren't there, ride a light cycle, and face the Warden, a giant soldier the war forgot.

5355280.name: Only Luck
5355280.short_description: Five sixes is a 1 in 7776 roll. How about 1 in 10? Only Luck is a pixel-art dice clicker: click to charge your throw, toss up to 9 dice, collect 1100 rare combinations and earn prestige chips. Upgrade your table, spin the Wheel of Luck and bend the rules until the impossible roll becomes routine.

5362060.name: The Third Seal
5362060.short_description: At a table in the dark, everyone secretly grabs a cursed object. When the light comes back, you find out who had it in for you. A first-person duel of horror and deception for 1 to 4 players, solo against the AI or online with friends. The third seal sets you free.

5373170.name: By The Sea : Pilgrimage of the Colorless
5373170.short_description: Walk through Claude Monet's paintings as a Great War veteran carrying his wife's ashes to the sea. Stop, look closer, and paint color back into the world he lost. A quiet, wordless pilgrimage where stillness is rewarded.

5381250.name: Grim Guild
5381250.short_description: You never go on the adventure. You only decide who does. Run the adventurers' guild your grandfather left you: find out what is out there, from dire wolves to a dragon in the old workings, write the contract, and wait at the door to count who comes back. Streaming? Name newcomers after your viewers.

5383370.name: Untitled Maze Game
5383370.short_description: This is an epic maze adventure all made by the genius bird guy.cs this game is probably only fun for 10 minutes but it is still worth a shot.

5389860.name: Zanoka
5389860.short_description: ZANOKA is a single-player roguelike action hack and slash and survivorlike where every sword swing is yours. Chain light and heavy cuts into combos, time your dodges and combine elemental upgrades against enemy waves and bosses. Every run is different, and every run can reveal a new build.

5391620.name: Beast Hunt
5391620.short_description: Hunt the Beast through deadly caves in this first-person survival horror game. Read the clues, map your route, and manage light, air, and sanity. Scavenge strange powers, evade giant spiders, and trust your deductions when it's time to take the shot.

5396090.name: One More Brick
5396090.short_description: A cozy incremental brick breaker on a scribbled sketchbook page. Smash bricks, collect the rewards, and buy upgrades until balls split, lasers fly, and the page gets wonderfully messy. Grow your skill tree, put the Infinite Breaker to work, and turn over a new page.

5404950.name: Foodland Puzzle
5404950.short_description: Foodland puzzle is simplictic jigsaw puzzle game with food themed images

5408070.name: Project Nekrios
5408070.short_description: A co-op sci-fi horror shooter for 1–4 players. Hold a derelict space station against endless waves of aliens: weld the barricades shut, haul in salvage with tractor beams, restore power, and build new rooms, weapons and upgrades to survive one more round.

5408150.name: Taskbar Parade
5408150.short_description: A desktop companion game: a tiny parade of cute animals walks along the top of your taskbar while you work. Pet them, catch sparkles on the road, grant their daily wishes, send them exploring, and collect hats, friends and souvenirs. Quiet by default — it never gets in the way.

5429970.name: Climb for Kittens
5429970.short_description: Build your way up a giant tree to rescue stranded kittens! Craft and connect different objects, create your own climbing paths, and overcome tricky heights. Every rescued kitten unlocks new building materials. Build higher, don't fall, and save them all!

588030.name: Derail Valley
588030.short_description: Drive massive trains and build your career in a vast open railway network. For both PC and VR.

774171.name: Muse Dash
774171.short_description: Paradise of parkour & rhythm game ★★★ — Muse Dash!!

1061090.name: Jump King
1061090.short_description: Take up the challenge and face true high-stakes platforming in Jump King! Struggle upwards in search of the Smoking Hot Babe of legend, but explore with care; a single missed jump could lead to a long fall back down...

1211020.name: Wobbly Life
1211020.short_description: Wobbly Life is a vibrant open-world physics sandbox. Play with your friends online or in local co-op, with exciting jobs, mini games and wacky story missions. Earn cash to spend in the world on clothes, vehicles and houses. There is a whole Wobbly World out there to explore!

1592190.name: BONELAB
1592190.short_description: BONELAB is an experimental physics action game. Explore a mysterious lab filled with weapons, enemies, challenges and secrets. Escape your reality, or wreak havoc. No wrong answers.

1735700.name: Back to the Dawn
1735700.short_description: Back to the Dawn is a story-rich RPG set in a high-security prison ruled by factions and buried secrets. Investigate two conspiracies from the inside, gather evidence, and outsmart a system designed to silence you. Make friends (or foes) with fellow inmates and with their help, break out of prison.

2195120.name: Go-Go Town!
2195120.short_description: Step into the role of a hands-on mayor and build your town from the ground up. Plan neighborhoods, automate logistics, and grow your community—all while juggling workers, infrastructure, and day-to-day chaos to create your dream town. Play solo for total control, or bring friends for co-op mayhem.

2401350.name: Timeless Rain
2401350.short_description: Explore this foreign world and manipulate time to navigate through the challenges that lie along your path! Meet the inhabitants of this strange realm as they push you towards finding the Timeless Rain...

2434930.name: Blue Ridge Hunting
2434930.short_description: Blue Ridge Hunting is a co-op horror game set in the Appalachian Mountains. Solo or with friends, investigate, document, and hunt cryptids based on real sightings, legends, and paranormal phenomena from the region.

2765990.name: Skullf!
2765990.short_description: Sure, we've all had fun in a graveyard, but have you ever tried macabre mini-golf amongst the tombstones?! Well NOW YOU CAN with SKULLF! Help your disembodied skull of terror into its grave. Dodge traps, spelunk tombs & go head-to-head with friends (friends not included) across 44+ fiendish levels!

2878450.name: Master of Command
2878450.short_description: Take command in Europe's greatest 18th-century war. Equip & customize regiments, manage supplies, and engage in brutal real-time battles across procedural campaigns. Resources and replacements are scarce, and keeping your best men alive may matter more than any single victory.

2949320.name: Ratatan
2949320.short_description: Ratatan is a rhythm roguelike action game that combines rhythm games and side-scrolling action, with online co-op gameplay supporting up to 4 players. An intense battle unfolds with over 100 characters fighting in a massive melee. Let's defeat the enemies together!

3194080.name: Calvar - The Darkest Gate
3194080.short_description: CALVAR – THE DARKEST GATE is a first-person psychological horror game created by a two-person indie team. Explore a world of fractured memories, ritual corruption, disturbing creatures, and an abandoned asylum where reality itself begins to unravel.

3310570.name: Night Plane
3310570.short_description: Night Plane is a job-sim horror game where you work as a flight attendant on a doomed plane. Check tickets, serve passengers, and decide who stays onboard as demons hide among innocent souls. Naturally, management says it’s your problem.

3370490.name: Giggleland
3370490.short_description: Tolie isn’t allowed to leave the house. One night she wakes up alone in Giggleland, to a voice over the park speakers: her father is waiting for her at the information booth. A first-person psychological horror game in eight chapters. This game is not suitable for children.

3590040.name: The Gassal
3590040.short_description: The dead find peace through sacred burial rites, washed, wrapped, and prepared for their final journey. As a burial washer, it is your duty to perform them with precision and respect. But with no one to guide you, how well can you fulfill this sacred task?

3712150.name: TCG Card Collection: Tidy Up
3712150.short_description: Organize and restore a special collection of 3,200 TCG cards. Clean each card and reveal their true glory. Match and sort them to sixteen themed sets. Turn a room full of chaos back to a collector's gallery.

3760770.name: Space Savory
3760770.short_description: Not that far away, in a galaxy… A diner with questionable hygiene, bubbling with dark secrets and darker humor, in the middle of cosmic nothingness. Welcome to Space Savory. Don’t be fooled by appearances, the best flavor in the universe is cooked right here. (Only within the observable part.)

3819640.name: Megastore Simulator
3819640.short_description: Megastore Simulator is a first-person management & tycoon game. Choose your starting department and build a massive two-floor megastore! Unlock 1,000+ unique products across 11 departments, from clothing to butchery. Hire staff and manage warehouse logistics with forklifts and pallet jacks.

3983810.name: The Spike Cross
3983810.short_description: "The thrill of spiking in volleyball. Why don't you try it out?" Developed by an indie developer who loves volleyball! The sports game made after numerous trial and error to contain the appeal of volleyball!

4192370.name: Droste Detective
4192370.short_description: A recursive anomaly and psychological horror where you wake up stuck in an office corridor and find out there is a framed photo of the corridor on the wall. There is something very strange about this picture...

4326130.name: Spooky Market
4326130.short_description: Spooky Market is a co-op shop simulator for 1–4 players set in a world of eternal Halloween. Open your own business, sell a variety of goods, serve vampires, skeletons, and other creatures, hire unusual employees, and gradually grow and expand your store.

4485570.name: Punch Upon a Time
4485570.short_description: Punch Upon a Time is a team-based party fighter inspired by Smash Bros where you take on rounds of modes, mini-games, and combat alongside your friends. Assemble a squad of the biggest fairy tale names to punch, dunk, fly, score, and sumo your way to victory as the LAST TEAM STANDING.

4634660.name: Your Friends Vs Hidebehind
4634660.short_description: A co-op survival horror game for 1-6 players. Record your real scream and it plays back when it takes you. Explore a procedurally generated forest, deny it by facing the terror, and escape before the forest decides you're staying.

4677860.name: The Spectacular Evermore
4677860.short_description: Learn each room of the theatre, spot anomalies, and photograph them to restore the room. Keep your eyes open for anything unusual, from living statues to possessed paintings.

4704520.name: ShredDead
4704520.short_description: ShredDead is a quirky relaxing incremental zombie-shredding game focused on progression with no lose conditions. Defeat endless waves, collect loot, grow your skill tree and evolve the zombies.

4709550.name: Behind the Corner
4709550.short_description: Explore dark vintage environments and survive encounters with a relentless entity in this first-person psychological horror game. Listen closely, watch the shadows, and face the unsettling feeling that something is waiting just around the corner.

4711310.name: How to Summon a Demon
4711310.short_description: Ready to summon a demon this Halloween? Three answers decide which of 20 demons answers your call. A short, fully voiced summoning ritual with a collection book for everyone who wants to summon them all!

4742590.name: Giraffe Champion 3: Halloween Party & The Ghost Guitar
4742590.short_description: Play rock and metal songs and compete against zombies, witches, ghosts in the guitar battle to get all your guitars back. You are going to perform at a Halloween party but zombies have stolen all your guitars. Collect all the guitars before the Halloween party starts!

4755440.name: Maximilien — A Psychological Horror Interactive Novel
4755440.short_description: A psychological horror interactive novel, Boston 1926. Explore, investigate, lose your footing. Your choices shape a branching story, while your mental state distorts the very page you read. 4 intersecting routes, 12 possible endings, 2 to 5 hours per playthrough.

4817620.name: One Way Tickets
4817620.short_description: “One Way Tickets” is a roguelite incremental adventure game where you embark on a exciting journey in a fantasy world. Choose your vehicle, equip your device and face challenges from all kinds of enemies. Ram! Unload bullets! Swing with all your might! Keep growing and push forward!

4829810.name: The Circus That Never Left
4829810.short_description: Step inside a circus performer's quiet home, but don't stop at the surface. In this short-form descent into dread, follow a hidden labyrinth deep beneath the floorboards and watch a simple investigation spiral into a claustrophobic nightmare.

4840960.name: 3 Switch Problem
4840960.short_description: A casual, 3D, observation and puzzle game. Flip switches and observe results to answer which switch is controlling an apparatus as you work your way through the nine challenges of the 3-Switch Problem Puzzle Park. Talk to other kids and play outdoor activities along the way.

4895300.name: Hack And Slash Fury 2: Lancelot Betrayal
4895300.short_description: Destroy the dark warriors with your sword at the rythm of heavy metal and see epic cinematics while you master the complex combat system to humilliate your rivals online or offline, here you will find fun, satire, and war created and combined like never before by his developer.

4949930.name: Fragments
4949930.short_description: Explore the LeBlanc hotel and reveal hidden illusions through Eugene’s camera, an archivist. Follow in Laura’s footsteps, an investigator working on the disappearance of Eugene's sister, 20 years ago. Armed with a camera and discretion, can you discover the hotel’s heart and its mysteries?

4968160.name: Kleromancy
4968160.short_description: What if Slay the Spire used dice instead of cards? Build your own 3D dice, customize their faces, and roll them with real physics in this turn-based roguelike. Create powerful combos, manipulate your rolls, and fight your way through 7 corrupted biomes.

4969270.name: Jarkeeper
4969270.short_description: A cozy first-person sorting game in a spooky old mansion on a stormy night. You sleepwalked out the front door, and all 3,120 specimen jars hit the floor. Carry armfuls, learn odd little spells from the bimbous and put every jar back on its shelf.

4992920.name: Stay with me
4992920.short_description: Answer a late night call to care for an elderly woman with dementia. Explore a haunted house, solve environmental puzzles and uncover a terrifying truth in this first person psychological horror experience.

5015190.name: Gorgeous Baby Bella
5015190.short_description: While her husband is away, Liora is forced to spend her days alone. But solitude is not as quiet as she thinks.

5048870.name: Scopa Sweep
5048870.short_description: Traditional Italian Scopa card game turned roguelike. Play against your rival and capture all the cards on the table while trying to score as many points as possible. Sweep the board with a SCOPA to increase your multiplier and complete objectives for permanent bonuses.

5062910.name: Life Is a Dungeon: Lean into It.
5062910.short_description: Choose one of four adventurers, each driven to clear dungeon floors in a different way. Set a destination or take direct control, then combine equipment with powerful—but sometimes troublesome—random skills to shape every expedition in this dungeon-crawling roguelite RPG.

5080430.name: TV Station Tycoon
5080430.short_description: Build and manage your own TV station. License shows, create schedules, attract viewers, sell advertising, grow your audience, and compete for the top spot in the ratings in this broadcasting management tycoon.

5105330.name: Eternal Chamber
5105330.short_description: A psychological horror about repetition, isolation, and the need to keep moving forward. Keep pushing. Don't stop. Break through.

5108270.name: SUMOO
5108270.short_description: SUMOO is a minimalist grid puzzle where numbers slide, meet, and add up. Every stage demands one exact number. Use pits, portals, and multipliers to land on it.

5111110.name: Night Drive - Anomaly
5111110.short_description: Night Drive - Anomaly is a supernatural driving horror game where you must navigate a mysterious endless night, spot anomalies, choose the right road, and survive until morning to escape the loop.

5127570.name: Terms of Service
5127570.short_description: Terms of Service is a short first-person psychological horror game where you answer 100 increasingly invasive Yes/No questions at an old CRT terminal. As the form becomes more cursed, disturbing memories bleed through the screen, the CRT deteriorates, and the agreement starts to feel less voluntary.

5130650.name: TOWERTOWER
5130650.short_description: Stack. Mislead. Wipe them out. A punishing tower defense about building a fortress out of stacked blocks. Every tower is a weapon, a wall, and a piece of terrain that leads enemies astray. Let 50 through and it is over.

5171850.name: Seven Doors
5171850.short_description: Seven Doors is a first-person horror game set in a mysterious world that resembles Korea's Joseon Dynasty. Explore dark and unsettling places, uncover hidden clues, and find a way to escape while hiding and running from terrifying entities lurking in the darkness.

5176280.name: SplitOut
5176280.short_description: Split Out - The Ultimate Auto Battle Racing Experience Embark on an epic journey through the world of rally racing in Split Out, where your dream of becoming the #1 racer in the Race of Champions begins with a single street kart and rise to the global championship glory.

5336080.name: Gacha Chaos Tidy Up Together
5336080.short_description: A cozy-chaotic co-op organizing sim. Sort 7,200 gacha capsules into 900 machines across 20 color zones, solo or with 1-4 players. Throw, catch, and SLAP capsules out of your friends' hands, unlock 13 team skills, and collect 100 capsule series. No timer, just chaos.

5336190.name: Wild Heroes: Fight Together
5336190.short_description: Team up with up to 3 friends in an online co-op action roguelite. Carve a path into the living Wild, battle monster packs in bramble arenas, topple three colossal bosses and come back stronger after every expedition.

5352720.name: MemeticBox
5352720.short_description: A brutal voxel gore sandbox. Every body is built from blocks you can shoot, slice, burn and blow apart. Play God: hurl people, strike them with lightning, hang them or impale them on spikes. Or grab a gun for Police raids, zombie waves and fully destructible cities.

5355200.name: SORT THEM ALPACAS: OVERLOAD!
5355200.short_description: Sort 5,000 alpaca plushies in a first-person collectathon with a touch of chaos. Spend your sorting earnings on a deep upgrade system, and discover five hidden powers with chaotic upgrades of their own.

5367960.name: Arcana
5367960.short_description: A poker roguelike with cheating bosses. Build hands, chain chips and multipliers with 21 arcana and face ten bosses who break the rules, all the way to THE JAILER, who keeps souls inside his deck.

5391120.name: Visa Quest
5391120.short_description: A dark-humor bureaucracy sim with a retro PSX look. You have 21 days to get a visa: collect papers in absurd office minigames, flip burgers on night shifts to pay for them, and decide what your father and your dog Karabas can live without.

5394900.name: Halloween Shop Simulator
5394900.short_description: Manage a Halloween shop in a town full of monsters. Furnish your home, adopt a weird pet, explore the streets and discover a nightlife full of secrets, smugglers and spooky surprises.

242640.name: Styx: Master of Shadows
242640.short_description: Styx: Master of Shadows is an infiltration game with RPG elements taking place in a dark fantasy universe, where you sneak, steal and assassinate your way through as Styx, a Goblin two-centuries of age.

434170.name: The Jackbox Party Pack 3
434170.short_description: The threequel to the party game phenomenon features the deadly quiz show Trivia Murder Party, the say-anything sequel Quiplash 2, the surprising survey game Guesspionage, the t-shirt slugfest Tee K.O., and the sneaky trickster game Fakin’ It.

982290.name: Airborne Kingdom
982290.short_description: The sky city builder awaits. Create your own flying kingdom and lead it on a quest across an expansive world. Explore the varied landscape, build up a floating metropolis, aid struggling people below, uncover lost secrets and, ultimately, bring back the Airborne Kingdom legend.

1253220.name: The Gold River Project
1253220.short_description: The Gold River Project™ is a camping trip gone wrong in the Pacific Northwest. Explore, craft, build, and survive in this open-world experiment that traps you and up to 4 friends in this single player or co-op survival adventure game.

1509960.name: PICO PARK
1509960.short_description: PICO PARK is a cooperative local/online multiplay action puzzle game for 2-8 players.

1805320.name: Romestead
1805320.short_description: Rome has fallen! Rebuild civilization in this action-adventure survival game for 1-8 players. Fight hordes of the walking dead, build settlements, restore the Roman gods... or kick back and farm with friends.

3405340.name: Megabonk
3405340.short_description: Smash your way through endless waves of enemies and grow absurdly powerful! Grab loot, level up, unlock characters and upgrade to create unique and crazy builds as you fend off hordes of creatures!

3510740.name: Normal Golf Game
3510740.short_description: A very normal golf simulator. Hit anything. Shoot from anywhere. But remember: you’re not leaving until Luke Muscat himself (Fruit Ninja, Jetpack Joyride) is satisfied.

3558600.name: Leafy Corner
3558600.short_description: Run a cute little plant shop in this cozy and relaxing game. Grow, sell, and care for a variety of real-life plants, help customers find their dream plants, complete orders, and customize your cozy shop just the way you like!

3628640.name: Marked Souls
3628640.short_description: How far would you go to undo death? Marked Souls is a psychological horror narrative adventure about grief, forbidden rituals, and a mystery buried for 13 years. Explore an isolated orphanage, uncover its secrets, build relationships, and make choices that shape the fate of its residents.

3981100.name: Leaf it Alone
3981100.short_description: Finally, it's that time of the year to clean up this leafy mess. It's been a while since the last time you've done it, so don't waste any second and derust your raking skills!

4599130.name: Haunted Brazil: File 01
4599130.short_description: Discover the dark side of Northeastern Brazil in a first-person horror mystery. Uncover century-old secrets, solve puzzles, and evade a relentless pursuer. The clock is ticking... Can you figure out which Brazilian legend is behind it all?

4821630.name: MarsCity3026
4821630.short_description: A game for kids and adults. Grapple, swing, move mechanical puzzle pieces. Play as a robot that solves mazes and mechanical puzzles. Each puzzle brings the atmosphere control fans back online so that the humans can wake from cryosleep.

4927070.name: Forged Cards
4927070.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where YOU forge the cards. Slot casts into molds, temper their power, and etch combo inscriptions. Pick your path, battle, bargain, or brave the unknown, then outplay your enemy in simultaneous, position-based combat. Each run is different and each deck yours.

5012790.name: DET-33
5012790.short_description: A bullet-heaven roguelite in the ruins of new London. Take contracts from four warring factions, build a gun that breaks the game, and reach the evac before the city closes over you. 700+ weapons, interlocking build engines, and a fresh map every run.

5085310.name: IncrementalOS
5085310.short_description: An incremental love letter to the 90s desktop. Start with a blank desktop and one icon, unlock programs, systems and minigames, make more money, and build your way up to a system worth bragging about.

5155450.name: Hidden Raccoons in Winter
5155450.short_description: Hidden Raccoons in Winter is a cozy pixel art hidden object game! Search for adorable raccoons hidden across handcrafted winter landscapes. Relax, take your time, and find them all!

5195600.name: QuestAway
5195600.short_description: A tiny idle RPG that lives next to your taskbar. Build a party of heroes, send them off to fight and get back to work. There's loot waiting when you come back. Twelve times a day, everyone takes on a giant Colossus together.

5230820.name: RE:COPY
5230820.short_description: Control a robot, push boxes, and copy sections of the grid in this Sokoban-style puzzle game. Plan what to copy, where to put it, and how to move the boxes beforehand. Work out the steps to match the arrangement of patterns on the boxes and walls to the target pattern.

5366400.name: Prism Core
5366400.short_description: A neon cyberpunk color-matching survival arcade game. Sync your color with incoming blocks to survive across 3 unique modes. Features active color system, shields, and 15 achievements. Fast-paced score attack gameplay with infinite replayability.

316790.name: Grim Fandango Remastered
316790.short_description: One of the most acclaimed adventure games of all time is now back, better than ever. Grim Fandango Remastered has the all the beautiful art and engaging story fans remember, but has also been remastered to look, sound, and control even better than the award-winning original release.

686810.name: Hell Let Loose
686810.short_description: Join the ever expanding experience of Hell Let Loose - a hardcore World War Two first person shooter with epic battles of 100 players with infantry, tanks, artillery, a dynamically shifting front line and a unique resource based RTS-inspired meta-game.

1071870.name: Biped
1071870.short_description: Biped is a coop action adventure game with a strong focus on moment-to-moment collaboration between 2 players.

1222700.name: A Way Out
1222700.short_description: A Way Out is an exclusively co-op adventure where you play the role of one of two prisoners making their daring escape from prison.

1392860.name: Little Nightmares III
1392860.short_description: Little Nightmares III is an atmospheric adventure game in which you follow the journey of Low and Alone, two best friends in search of a way out of the Nowhere. In 2 players online cooperation or solo with an A.I., work together to solve puzzles and survive in this nightmarish world.

1435790.name: Escape Simulator
1435790.short_description: First-person puzzler you can play solo or in an online co-op. Explore a set of highly interactive escape rooms. Move furniture, pick up and examine everything, smash pots and break locks! Play thousands of community-made rooms through the level editor.

1527950.name: Wartales
1527950.short_description: Wartales is an open world RPG in which you lead a group of mercenaries in their search for wealth across a massive medieval universe. Explore the world, recruit companions, collect bounties and unravel the secrets of the tombs of the ancients!

2553750.name: ShootAndJump
2553750.short_description: Every shot moves you. Each bullet's recoil knocks you back across a tiny chessboard surrounded by conveyor belts. Dodge, ram and chain shots with two guns, survive 5–10 boss waves, and build your run from 398 cards across 20 archetypes.

3758440.name: Maja Island
3758440.short_description: Sail through a mysterious open world island in your trusty boat, scavenge for resources to upgrade it, and face off against Maja.

3946950.name: Click the Button
3946950.short_description: Click the Button is an incremental game about clicking a button to receive chests that deliver incredible rewards. Improve your skills to become the strongest.

4024120.name: 颂声·市井小神仙
4024120.short_description: This isn’t a wealth game, but an immersive experience warming ordinary town life. From mending the first tile to managing the street’s economic lifeline, every choice reshapes the town’s dawn and dusk. As the inn’s lanterns glow at dusk, your The Moonlit Scroll unfolds slowly...

4088450.name: RESIDUUM
4088450.short_description: RESIDUUM is a first-person psychological horror game set in a decaying research facility. Armed with only a dwindling flashlight and a faulty heartbeat sensor, manage your power, uncover the truth, and escape what hides in the dark.

4174240.name: Dédale - A Cave Diving Experience
4174240.short_description: This cave diving expedition was a bad idea. Your heart is racing, lungs are starving for fresh air, and this burrow never seems to end. Keep crawling. Dédale is a horror game that plunges you in a cave diving expedition that is bound to go wrong.

4630260.name: Room Zero
4630260.short_description: A first-person psychological mystery set in a liminal space that should not exist.

4656810.name: Reunion Fate
4656810.short_description: Reunion Fate is a psychological horror game where terror lurks in the places you think are safe. Use the flame to guide you through the darkness. Explore familiar and unfamiliar places. Hide from them. No one will tell you what you want to hear.

4728390.name: Sack Investigation
4728390.short_description: Sack Investigation an online multiplayer co-op casual puzzle platforming game. Join with up to 7 of your friends to explore and investigate the innerworkings of a magical and whimsical wizard tower. Find and destroy the cursed objects to progress and upgrade your Sack.

5173940.name: 方块战场 Block Battlefield
5173940.short_description: 《方块战场 Block Battlefield》 is a light Roguelike game that combines real-time falling blocks with auto-battler combat. By clearing blocks, you can deploy soldiers, choose random upgrades, and break through enemy fortresses. Build your block army and push your limits on an ever-changing battlefield!

5377010.name: OUTVOTE - Steam Version
5377010.short_description: How many of your friends would say yes? Answer questions in secret, then guess how the room voted – or call every player's answer. Play with Steam friends, or with anyone in the browser. Free, up to 20 players.

5398150.name: Battle SHIRYU
5398150.short_description: Real model footage × generative AI! Show your hand to a webcam and Battle SHIRYU recognizes it automatically! Steer a handmade paper dragon, smash matching-colour Moai, and set off chain explosions. No special markers or prepared backdrop needed. Mouse controls are available too.

238320.name: Outlast
238320.short_description: Hell is an experiment you can't survive in Outlast, a first-person survival horror game developed by veterans of some of the biggest game franchises in history. As investigative journalist Miles Upshur, explore Mount Massive Asylum and try to survive long enough to discover its terrible secret... if you dare.

352500.name: Task Bar Isekai
352500.short_description: Kenta worked himself to death at 3:47 AM… and was reborn under your taskbar. An idle ARPG that fights while you work: loot, forge to +15, beat bosses that break out onto your desktop, and seal your best drops as real Steam items to trade or sell on the Steam Community Market.

414700.name: Outlast 2
414700.short_description: Outlast 2 introduces you to Sullivan Knoth and his followers, who left our wicked world behind to give birth to Temple Gate, a town, deep in the wilderness and hidden from civilization. Knoth and his flock are preparing for the tribulations of the end of times and you’re right in the thick of it.

424840.name: Little Nightmares
424840.short_description: Take on the role of Six, a lone child lost in a massive metal vessel known as the Maw, surrounded by dangerous, distorted versions of adults. You’ll need to do your best to escape in one piece or your fate will be worse than you ever dared dream.

541570.name: Sally Face - Episode One
541570.short_description: An unsettling adventure following a boy with a prosthetic face. After a string of mysterious murders, Sal and his three friends discover something truly sinister casting shadows over their small town.

594330.name: Visage
594330.short_description: Visage is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore a mysterious ever-changing house in a slow-paced, atmospheric world that combines both uncannily comforting and horrifyingly realistic environments, and enjoy a genuinely terrifying experience.

653530.name: Return of the Obra Dinn
653530.short_description: Lost at sea 1803 ~ The good ship Obra Dinn.

692850.name: Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night
692850.short_description: Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night is an exploration-focused, side-scroller action RPG by Koji Igarashi. Play as Miriam, an orphan scarred by an alchemist's curse that slowly crystallizes her body. Battle through a demon-infested castle and defeat its master to save yourself, and all of humanity!

953490.name: CARRION
953490.short_description: CARRION is a reverse horror game in which you assume the role of an amorphous creature of unknown origins, stalking and consuming those that imprisoned you.

1003590.name: Tetris® Effect: Connected
1003590.short_description: Tetris® Effect: Connected adds an all-new robust multiplayer expansion to the huge variety of addictive and innovative single-player modes that Tetris Effect is known for, with all-new co-op and competitive online and local multiplayer modes!

1150690.name: OMORI
1150690.short_description: Explore a strange world full of colorful friends and foes. When the time comes, the path you’ve chosen will determine your fate... and perhaps the fate of others as well.

1169040.name: Necesse
1169040.short_description: Build, quest, and conquer across an infinite procedurally generated world. Play alone or with friends as you establish a settlement and explore deep dungeons, fight monsters and bosses, mine rare ores, craft magical equipment, recruit specialists for your colony, and more!

1179080.name: FAITH: The Unholy Trinity
1179080.short_description: What you are about to do has not been approved by the Vatican. As a young priest, struggle against demons, cultists, and your own weakening faith in this pixel horror game inspired by the era of classic 8-bit gaming and the "Satanic Panic" of the 1980s.

1244090.name: Sea of Stars: Sunset Edition
1244090.short_description: Sea of Stars is a turn-based RPG inspired by the classics. It tells the story of two Children of the Solstice who will combine the powers of the sun and moon to perform Eclipse Magic, the only force capable of fending off the monstrous creations of the evil alchemist known as The Fleshmancer.

1295920.name: The Mortuary Assistant
1295920.short_description: Alone with the dead... Embalm corpses, banish demons, save your soul.

1575990.name: Twisted Tower
1575990.short_description: Blast your way through an abandoned 1950s theme park crawling with fairy-tale mascots, twisted puzzles, and deadly traps. Uncover the dark secrets of your past as you race to the top to win back the love of your life.

1663850.name: REPLACED
1663850.short_description: Follow R.E.A.C.H., an AI trapped in a human body, on a cinematic adventure through an alternate 1980s America. Explore an atmospheric cyberpunk world full of high-stakes action wrapped in a unique 2.5D pixel art style.

1946060.name: EvilTrap
1946060.short_description: EvilTrap is set in a cursed village where an endless night forces you to seek fleeting refuge. Hunted by something that listens and remembers, you will quickly learn that a deep evil consumes this place. Hide, survive, and find a way out.

1996010.name: Crow Country
1996010.short_description: The year is 1990. It’s been two years since the mysterious disappearance of Edward Crow and the abrupt closure of his theme park, Crow Country. But your arrival has broken the silence, Mara Forest. If you want answers, you’ll have to venture deep into the darkness of Crow Country to find them…

2073250.name: Rift of the NecroDancer
2073250.short_description: The NecroDancer's back in an all-new rhythm game! Dragged into a strange new world, Cadence must engage in musical combat with monsters surging through the Rift! Face pulse-pounding Rhythm Rifts where every beat is a battle, all set to an original soundtrack by Danny Baranowsky & friends.

2415710.name: Alembix TCG
2415710.short_description: Brew the periodic table into a card game. A free-to-play alchemical TCG where every creature is an element and every fusion is a real reaction.

2899240.name: BUZZ or DIE
2899240.short_description: The rules are simple. Dive into your opponent's mindscape and search for secrets. Turn those secrets into content and make a short video. Gain the most Likes from the audience to win.

3035770.name: Pawnie: Focus Pals
3035770.short_description: Pawnie: Focus Pals is a productivity desktop companion. Pawnie lives on top of Windows and acts as a reflection of the user's effort, promoting focus and well-being through a positive reinforcement system and environment personalization.

3335490.name: SkyFab
3335490.short_description: Stranded on a floating island in the shadow of a mysterious cube planet, you must survive using only your wits and advanced engineering. Build intricate automation lines, manage power grids, and transform a single tree into a sprawling industrial space station. Will you find your way home?

3373660.name: Look Outside
3373660.short_description: Look Outside is a survival horror RPG set in a single apartment building. A mysterious event turns anyone who looks out the window into grotesque monsters, leaving the world in absolute chaos. Scavenge the building to seek food, supplies, and weapons while encountering strange characters.

3431040.name: That's not my Neighbor
3431040.short_description: It's 1955, and for unknown reasons, doppelgangers are more common than usual. Therefore, the Department of Doppelganger Detection (D.D.D.) has taken action. You are the doorman of an apartment complex, and you must decide whether to let in those who claim to be your neighbors.

3560890.name: Rushmark
3560890.short_description: Your dash is your weapon. On the ground it's back in under a second. In the air you get one, and only a kill buys another. A cyberpunk speedrunning platformer: wall-kick, chain and strike through ten handmade courses in thirty-second runs, then race any rival's ghost off the leaderboard.

3808810.name: Prismarch
3808810.short_description: A colorful chess roguelike!
