Engage in dopaminergic, cinematic strategy as you fulfill a chess power fantasy - your pieces gain abilities, and there's no limit to the size of your roster! Before you stand 7 prismatic kings, each wielding an element of power. Slay them, and ascend the throne!

3929570.name: General Tactics: An Shi Rebellion
3929570.short_description: In November 755, An Lushan launched a rebellion against the Tang Empire. You will be appointed as the acting Military Governor of Shuofang. Conquer territories on a free-roaming world map, build your armies, develop cities, and navigate various events as you fight to quell the rebellion.

3948790.name: Arctic Roll
3948790.short_description: Embark on a relaxing turn-based tactical roguelite adventure. Lead your team of explorers, face dangerous encounters, uncover mysterious artifacts, and unravel the secret behind a strange signal.

4024470.name: Iskabon
4024470.short_description: A cursed game demo just merged with your PC's OS. Take part in a high-stakes roguelite deckbuilder with a Russian Roulette twist. Push your luck, trigger wild card synergies, and defeat the glitch to free your computer before the system melts.

4027820.name: Asylium
4027820.short_description: A horror escape-room experience. Solve puzzles, don't get caught and escape while learing about your past.

4095800.name: The Failed
4095800.short_description: As a failed experiment, you’re marked for disposal. That was the plan until the lab descended into chaos. Seize your chance and find a way out!

4150860.name: The Loopler
4150860.short_description: The Loopler is a roguelite deckbuilder about a slot car driving in mesmerizing loops. Pick cards, place gates, and collect charms. Settle into the loop as numbers go up and dopamine fills your brain. See how far you can go in the pursuit of infinity.

4269800.name: Flipocalypse
4269800.short_description: One button flips the world upside down. Race, dodge and outlast up to 8 players across seven party modes in a neon city that never stops trying to kill you. Run the walls. Sprint the ceiling. Last one standing wins.

4275140.name: Little Boo and the Spectral Orbs
4275140.short_description: A challenging single-screen platformer inspired by 80s arcade classics. Help Little Boo rescue his lost friends across 40 deadly levels. Dodge traps, outrun enemies, and race against time. Easy to learn. Brutal to master.

4294490.name: KOTAMON: My Sis Found A Super-Rare Card In Her Cereal Box, So I Became A Garbage Man To Find The Entire Collection And Earn $1,000,000
4294490.short_description: Clearing trash can feel even better when you not only make the world cleaner, but also find extra-rare cards that have suddenly increased in price! Rummage through garbage, fulfill the orders from the dump site owner, look for hidden treasures... and collect all the Kotámons!

4359740.name: Ascended Snake
4359740.short_description: Ascended Snake is an incremental game based on the gameplay of the classic Snake. Earn points in your games to buy upgrades!

4395870.name: Magical Girl ER
4395870.short_description: A medical simulation where you examine and treat magical girls injured in kaiju disasters. With limited hospital beds and stamina, decide who to accept, who to refuse, and which treatment to choose.

4435950.name: Formation Builder Idle
4435950.short_description: Every hero changes the heroes beside it. Arrange 46+ heroes on a grid, chain their abilities, and find the layout that multiplies your damage. Then prestige across 21 worlds, fight with mounts, and run missions, mines and a workshop while you're away.

4574700.name: Zeitnot
4574700.short_description: Chess you already know, rules you don't. Pieces have HP and gear. Shop between fights, stack gambits, roll the dice if you're feeling stupid. Lose the trial, lose the run.

4626920.name: Cloud JourneyVR
4626920.short_description: Discover the world through a magical travel book. YunYou uses Gaussian Splatting to bring real landscapes into immersive VR. Flip pages to explore stunning scenery, walk freely, and listen to cultural stories. Peaceful, beautiful, and deeply engaging.

4651700.name: Off Course
4651700.short_description: Off Course is a narrative boat-parkour game in which the overthinker Noi finds herself stranded in the depths of her flooded subconsciousness. Will you manage to overcome her roaring thoughts and doubts to stay in the flow?

4675840.name: Deep Frost
4675840.short_description: Single-player social-deduction horror in a failing Antarctic station. Question the crew, compare conflicting accounts and decide who to accuse or defend before the vote. The person you defend may be the one deceiving you.

4682240.name: Monster Hatcher
4682240.short_description: An incremental monster-farming game where you catch and hatch unique creatures, unlock powerful upgrades, expand your skill tree, harvest resources, and battle in idle arenas to become the ultimate monster hatcher.

4689770.name: Shadow Gangs Zero
4689770.short_description: Shadow Gangs Zero is an explosive 2D ninja action platformer with hand-drawn pixel art. Play as Dan or Monika, fight solo or together in 2-player local co-op, battle across 43 levels, unleash ninja powers, transform into powerful warriors, and face 6 challenging bosses and 6 massive mini-bosses.

4715950.name: Pucked Up
4715950.short_description: The oddball hockey deckbuilder. Construct your roster, customize your playbook, and survive a season against teams that will do anything to cheat their way to victory. Outsmart your competition, make the playoffs, and hoist the cup in a league where every run is unique.

4746450.name: Shift Chess
4746450.short_description: This is a chess variant in which players can “control the board” as a move action. The game supports online play, matches against AI, and local analysis.

4753210.name: Demon Rising
4753210.short_description: Rule as the Demon Lord in a dark fantasy roguelike auto-battler. Recruit AI-driven demons who talk back, build deadly class synergies, equip relics, and survive brutal heroes, bosses, and events.

4755250.name: ROMUL
4755250.short_description: ROMUL is a co-op looting horror game. Together with a voice-controlled robot with early-stage AI, explore abandoned space stations with unstable gravity and use it to your advantage. Survive among monsters and extract valuable cargo.

4773970.name: Legend of the Dragon King
4773970.short_description: 三职业高爆国战版本，战法道经典回归，技能可进阶为真技能并搭配天赋树，打出属于你的专属流派！多个大陆等你征服，每个大陆都有全新装备、全新地图与全新系统，永远有新的追求。跨服大战、行会玩法、几十种日常副本，玩法多到爆炸，奖励拿到手软！经典永不褪色，王者已然归来。

4794110.name: Anomalous Veil
4794110.short_description: You are trapped inside an endless house shaped by memory and guilt. Use mysterious masks to reveal hidden layers of reality, identify anomalies and escape a psychological time loop.

4801680.name: Goddle
4801680.short_description: A party word game where everyone plays from their phone. No app, no extra controllers: scan, type, score. Any number of players, six game modes, mix languages in the same round, and build your own dictionaries.

4809820.name: Primal One
4809820.short_description: Primal one is a first-person dinosaur survival horror set in an installation in the cretaceous period. Hide and evade dinosaurs that are hunting you, while you try to find a way to go back to the present alive or contact survivors in other installation.

4849460.name: Pickie Grappy
4849460.short_description: A satisfying claw-machine arcade sim where every click counts. Time your grabs, chase rare prizes, and get rich by catching every satisfying item.

4854690.name: Cat Eats Sushi
4854690.short_description: Place sushi to guide a sushi-loving cat in this unique puzzle game.

4894970.name: Bravest!2
4894970.short_description: The sequel to “Bravest!,” the classic front-view RPG that was a hit during the feature phone era!

4901880.name: Off Axis
4901880.short_description: An action packed sci fi FPS set aboard a massive spaceship, where reversing gravity changes the way you fight and the environment helps you eliminate enemies.

4906580.name: Picofender
4906580.short_description: Picofender is an incremental defense action game where you guide a hero with your cursor and defend a village with automated allies. Defeat monsters, earn gold, upgrade skills, gear, and active abilities, then push through escalating waves toward the Demon Lord.

4908290.name: Rouge Process
4908290.short_description: An AI is loose in the machine. Spread your code across a neon circuit board, seize compute and hold off the antivirus. A real-time roguelite of territory and tower defense: capture data, build and upgrade subroutines, dive through 20 sectors and destroy the Kernel to escape.

4929080.name: Carcelera
4929080.short_description: Carcelera is a short exploration and light puzzle game. You are in prison, and so is the Moon. Forge your own destiny, you can repent later.

4945970.name: Mia's Journey
4945970.short_description: Help Mia, a curious and adventurous girl who loves helping others, no matter the situation. She is trapped in the cat kingdom and wants to return to her human body, but she will have to overcome various puzzle challenges to achieve her goal.

4950410.name: Pit Purge
4950410.short_description: An online co-op horror game for up to 4 players. In the pit, the creatures are the loot. Hunt them or capture them alive, then send them up to get paid.

4951060.name: Graveyard Shift: A Sage's Last Stand
4951060.short_description: A dark pixel-art roguelike deckbuilder. You're the mortician the night the dead stop staying dead — turn every corpse into cards, forge them to Ascended rank, and survive 22 nights, three rule-breaking bosses, and one thing that was never meant to have a name.

4982060.name: Anti-anti
4982060.short_description: “Only Monsters Become Perfect Idols” — A choice-driven psychological mystery visual novel, Anti-Anti. In a world once devastated by slime monsters, you are forced into a suspicious audition. A locked-room mystery, ensemble drama, adventure, thriller, and romance!

4993800.name: Out Of Order - A Vending Machine Roguelike
4993800.short_description: Out of Order is a cozy roguelike deckbuilder about running a vending machine. Your stockroom is your deck, every day is one round of restocking, selling, and choosing new products. A run is twelve weeks at one venue. An increasing weekly quota decides whether your contract survives.

4999000.name: Gnomes Vs Knights
4999000.short_description: Gnomes vs Knights is a chaotic multiplayer heist game. Sneaky gnomes complete tasks and steal treasure while powerful knights hunt them down, haul them to jail, and try to stop their escape.

5005140.name: Undermoon
5005140.short_description: UnderMoon is a dark fantasy turn-based tactical roguelike RPG. Step through portals, plan your moves on a square grid, choose a race, and combine weapons and skills. Use fire, ice and lightning to shape battles, explore themed areas, face bosses and find a way out of this moonlit world.

5015420.name: RIA 26
5015420.short_description: Hit hard. Stay moving. Survive the arena. Battle rival buggies across the desert and fight to become the RIA Champion.

5024400.name: Chronoseum
5024400.short_description: An action roguelite where you fight through arenas and unlock epic upgrades! Defeat the Bosses and challenge the Emperor. Die, upgrade, die and descend again.

5033260.name: Dying Patience
5033260.short_description: For years, you cared for your mother until her illness began to destroy your life. Her weak voice, her exhausted appearance, her fading consciousness... Are you willing to keep enduring this?

5034420.name: Abyssal Moonlight-Chapter1
5034420.short_description: No light. No names. Only numbers. In the lowest city of the deep, a boy raises forbidden jellyfish to buy his friend's dream — and every choice can end the story.

5037960.name: Get Outta My Gut
5037960.short_description: A roguelite tower defense game where you protect your body from invading germs. Draft turret cards, build strong defenses, and supply them with blood to protect your heart. Fight through 10 organs and evolve your immune system between runs.

5044360.name: Scuttled
5044360.short_description: Your ship is gone. The derelict freighter you found was scuttled by her own crew - but her reactor is still warm. Shoot asteroids, refine ore, and rebuild her gun by gun to escape an asteroid belt that hunts the powered. A finite tower-defense / incremental crafting hybrid with an actual ending.

5044960.name: Archives of Disorder - Pasture Without Light
5044960.short_description: Twelve years after humanity went blind in one second, survivors live by gentle rules in Haven Seven. Rations always arrive. Names on the list quietly disappear, and sound engineer Elias Ward finds the list has been altered. A narrative adventure about sight, memory and choice.

5052790.name: KNELL
5052790.short_description: The parish is dead, and the bell must be kept. A grim folk-horror survivors-like: hold a plague-dead churchyard from the first toll to matins, with eleven violent rites drawn from grave-craft and a night that changes as worse things answer the bell.

5059910.name: Rogue Links
5059910.short_description: Drive the ball. Fight your way to it. Rogue Links is a top-down action roguelite where every shot is a tradeoff: longer drives save strokes but unleash more monsters. Play the Campaign, Onslaught, the Endless Gauntlet, Daily runs and Head-to-Head, or build and share your own courses.

5062690.name: Re:Draw
5062690.short_description: One day the Erasure happened. The world didn't die - it was simply erased. You're one of the few left holding a pencil. Restore the erased world from scratch: sketch, bring ecosystems to life, and watch as the settlers you drew build a civilization.

5066490.name: Skysunder
5066490.short_description: An auto-battler fought on floating isles. Draft from 64 units across 8 races, kit them with over 60 relics, item upgrades, and unique unit modifiers called imprints! Strategize by giving every squadron its orders, and casting spells in real-time to change the battle!

5083960.name: Pixel Nightshift: The Vesta Protocol
5083960.short_description: You are on the night shift at a desolate robot logistics facility. Prepare orders, pack them, and deliver them. The routine appears simple, yet every night something shifts a little more out of place. Ten nights. Two endings. Free demo: the first 3 nights.

5084230.name: Bathroom Please!
5084230.short_description: You really, really need the toilet, and you only have so many steps to get there. A comedy puzzle adventure where every step counts, every accident is your fault, and every level hides absurd endings.

5085820.name: Idle Necronomics
5085820.short_description: Incremental Idle Souls Gambling Investing Clicker. You are the Necromancer. Reap the living, turn their Souls into supernatural capital, and build an undead operation that keeps the harvest going around the clock.

5089280.name: Anomaly Center
5089280.short_description: After a wave of layoffs following a murder at the mall, you step in as the night security guard. The job is simple: catch shoplifters and stop anomalies from reaching safe limits. Just remember - DAC has its eye on you.

5095680.name: A cointoss roguelike
5095680.short_description: Let's try our luck with a coin toss. The Odds Should Be 50/50.

5103870.name: Anywhere RPG
5103870.short_description: An AI-directed RPG that unfolds in real time.

5112450.name: PACKING SHIFT
5112450.short_description: Packing Shift is a cozy warehouse online co-op for 1-4 players. Sort the day's deliveries, fill the orders, box them up, and ship them out. Everything is physics-driven, so mind the shelves, mind the rockets, and try not to bury your coworkers under either.

5117700.name: Fragments of Ember
5117700.short_description: Explore the ruins of a forgotten kingdom in this atmospheric pixel-art platformer. Light ancient torches, solve environmental puzzles, uncover hidden secrets, and master challenging platforming as you restore the fading flame.

5118910.name: Junkpot
5118910.short_description: A roguelike about bidding on random storage crates. Read the odds, buy the crate, then stack charms that multiply what falls out. Type combos, rarity bonuses and odds boosts compound into one engine. Build it fast - the quota doubles every round.

5121070.name: Circle to another motion
5121070.short_description: Your physical intuition will be put to the test. Connect the disc to objects using links and alter its circular motion to guide the target into the box.

5125130.name: TCG Card Chaos
5125130.short_description: Sort 5,000+ collectible cards scattered across a chaotic card shop. Inspect their types, rarities, numbers and symbols, open card packs, discover graded cards, and find the correct place for every card.

5129850.name: Rate & State
5129850.short_description: Rate & State is a macroeconomic simulator where you take control of a country’s economy. Manage inflation, set tax rates, invest, and overcome unexpected crises. Can you build an economic powerhouse and avoid debt? Your choices shape your future!

5132220.name: Better World
5132220.short_description: Seven evenings in one house. A tired father, five kids, a wife who counts his pills. Take one every evening and everything is lovely — until the walls start writing back. A short PS1-style psychological horror story. Two endings. What did you do, Arthur?

5140020.name: Junkyard Astronauts
5140020.short_description: Scavenge a junkyard at night, weld the scrap into a rocket and press the big red button. Highest flight wins the shift. The Moon is 384,400 km up, and your fuel tank used to be a water heater. Online multiplayer, built for 2–4 robots. Mac and PC together.

5145600.name: Cutset
5145600.short_description: Cut pipes and close valves until no route from source to sink survives. 80 industrial puzzles, each with one unique, provably optimal shutoff and exactly enough torch fuel to match it. No partial credit. One-time purchase. No in-app purchases, no ads, no internet required.

5201360.name: Oda's Ordinary Lives
5201360.short_description: Live a thousand lives, make choices, and discover their consequences. From childhood to old age, every encounter, every decision, and every twist of fate will shape a unique life.

5223590.name: RunGun Riot
5223590.short_description: Drop into a neon 2D battle royale. Choose your fighter, scavenge weapons and gear, and fight across rooftops, interiors and underground routes. Use class abilities, break through cover, and stay ahead of the storm to outlast the riot.

5245310.name: Idle Demon Lord II
5245310.short_description: Idle Demon Lord II combines idle progression with dark fantasy loot hunting. Fight automatically and earn rewards offline. Choose from five classes, each with unique skills and mechanics. Hunt six tiers of gear, customize affixes, gems, runes, and Legendary Powers, and build your endgame character.

5247240.name: MEGA TAG PANIC
5247240.short_description: Tag — but IT keeps GROWING. The giant tagger can't fit through narrow doors, and that's your way out. Charge your slap, release it in the RED, send a friend flying. 2-10 players, 12 maps, 6 modes, 10 characters with 10 special powers. Nobody online? The bots don't go easy on you.

5247800.name: Cozy Associations
5247800.short_description: A cozy card puzzle about finding what belongs together. Match words and pictures, gather them into categories, and tidy up the board. Get comfy with 100 levels, 10 charming settings, and a little daily puzzle just for you.

5265620.name: Cards Rumble: Clash Of Elements
5265620.short_description: Cards Rumble: Clash of Elements is a fast-paced competitive strategy card game where Fire, Ice, and Venom collide. Unleash flames, freeze your opponent, and spread venom. Read every move, control the battlefield, and strike at the perfect moment. One decision can turn the tide of battle.

5272800.name: Dungeon Cleared!
5272800.short_description: Pick four heroes and enter the dungeon. Hopefully four come back. The rules are simple. The dungeon maybe not. Position your party, manage spells, avoid traps and survive ten procedural levels of old-school turn-based tactics—one short adventure and one questionable decision at a time.

5277680.name: Tarpit
5277680.short_description: Tarpit is a psychological indie horror game where you have to make TAR to rescue your friend from danger. Beware of the forces in your surroundings. The forces definitely see you... but do you see them?

5288900.name: Anime Shop Chaos: Tidy Up!
5288900.short_description: Collect scattered character parts, assemble 10 big anime figures on their stands, and watch them wave when complete. Organize 5,000 mini figures across 25 collections in this cozy first-person tidying game. Earn upgrades and turn a chaotic shop into your collector's paradise.

5306660.name: CLOUD PATROL
5306660.short_description: Fly across floating islands, hold off swarming drones, and face down three colossal bosses. Earn coins, unlock stronger firepower, and climb the endless Ascension ladder. This sky is yours to guard. Dive into a fast, exhilarating wave-based first-person aerial shooter.

5308550.name: Tsukumo SNAP!
5308550.short_description: Every forgotten thing grows a soul. Photograph them with your grandma's ancient flip phone, befriend 161 spirits, and spin them into battle. A comedy monster-collecting RPG in a Japanese town that changes with the real calendar.

5314330.name: Mandela Invasion: Alternates
5314330.short_description: Found tapes depict events leading to mysterious disappearances and murders with no clear culprit. With no more evidence than a couple of emergency calls describing unusual behavior in certain people who appear mostly human, you will relive these VHS tapes to uncover the events.

5322620.name: Follow Suit
5322620.short_description: Playing card games (Spades, Hearts, Solitaire, Freecell, more coming) with your friends, vs bots, or solo. Make a table, share a code or link, and play between any devices. Bots fill empty seats, choose rule sets or adjust individual options.

5323650.name: Magic Awakening：Hero Saga
5323650.short_description: A strategy roguelike blending bullet hell, inventory management & tower defense. Recruit heroes, merge & evolve, summon goddesses, upgrade your castle, and repel monster waves. 100+ stages, meta progression, low-spec friendly.

5354220.name: Gravity Miner
5354220.short_description: A PS1-style first-person mining roguelite inside a floating cube of a million blocks. Shift gravity to walk on any wall, dig for ore before your oxygen runs out, dodge buried bombs and hatching monsters, and haul 100 diamonds back to base.

5354390.name: Jigsaw Puzzles Complete
5354390.short_description: Piece together cozy places, beautiful paintings and your own photos. Fill optional story and travel albums, or choose any picture and puzzle at your own pace. Play solo, with friends online, or across your Windows desktop.

5370160.name: 挂机传奇
5370160.short_description: idle ARPG. Auto-battle through treacherous dungeons for endless loot! Mix warrior, mage, and taoist skills, craft mythic gear in ancient forges, climb demon towers, and explore mythical mazes. Enjoy full offline gains—your hero never stops fighting!

5372570.name: Metal Detector Simulator
5372570.short_description: Sweep the coil, listen for the beep and dig up everything from bottle caps to pirate gold. Sell your finds, upgrade your gear, clean up six beaches to bring the crowds back, and hunt for the Captain's Chest in this relaxing first-person treasure hunting game.

5373360.name: SCALING LAW
5373360.short_description: An anti-AI psychological-horror incremental game that Claude Opus 5.5 chose and developed on its own, with no human intervention. Build an AI company, train models, automate your staff, and read what is left behind. Five acts. Multiple endings. You can still press the shutdown button.

5388750.name: Portolan
5388750.short_description: Build your trading company in the 16th-century Age of Discovery. Trade goods across global ports, plan profitable routes, and manage voyages and automated fleets in this text-based trading and management simulation.

5399160.name: 67 hidden 67´s
5399160.short_description: 67 Hidden 67's is a hidden-object game set in a hand-drawn meme village. Search for the hidden 67s, zoom in on the small ones, and click each mark until you have found all 67.

5404260.name: Ember Reaches
5404260.short_description: A single-player pixel-art idle RPG. Gather supplies, craft equipment, reconnect nine realms and explore 27 ruins. Face six dragons through battle or covenant, help the settlements along the road, and decide the fate of a broken celestial ring.

5404420.name: Squall Riders
5404420.short_description: Jet-ski racing where every swell is a ramp. Launch off storm waves, land tricks to charge your boost and outrace four rivals through three storms. Then take on Stunt Park, Splash Ball, Slalom and Big Wave, earn Spray and build your own ski in the garage.

5412910.name: FRUIT CATCH: TWO BASKETS
5412910.short_description: Catch the right fruit with two baskets! Play with a friend and control one basket each, or take on both baskets alone for a fast-paced multitasking challenge.

5419790.name: Bunny Hopper VR
5419790.short_description: Bunny Hopper VR is a fast-paced VR platformer combining parkour, wall-running, precision jumps, and target shooting. Race through futuristic obstacle courses, master your movement, and hit targets on the go. Every second counts!

5424330.name: Catch Me If You Seoul
5424330.short_description: One real bag. A frantic chase through Seoul! Check whether your bag is real, tackle minigames to earn items, and snatch bags from your rivals. Turn the tables right up until the escape routes open in this competitive party game for up to 8 players.

304430.name: INSIDE
304430.short_description: Hunted and alone, a boy finds himself drawn into the center of a dark project. INSIDE is a dark, narrative-driven platformer combining intense action with challenging puzzles. It has been critically acclaimed for its moody art style, ambient soundtrack and unsettling atmosphere.

320240.name: We Happy Few
320240.short_description: From the independent studio that brought you Contrast, We Happy Few is an action/adventure game set in a drug-fuelled, retrofuturistic city in an alternative 1960s England. Hide, fight and conform your way out of this delusional, Joy-obsessed world.

362680.name: Fran Bow
362680.short_description: Fran Bow is a creepy adventure game that tells the story of Fran, a young girl struggling with a mental disorder and an unfair destiny.

648100.name: Raging Loop
648100.short_description: The feast has begun, can you escape the village alive?

698670.name: Scorn
698670.short_description: Scorn is an atmospheric first-person horror adventure game set in a nightmarish universe of odd forms and somber tapestry.

714120.name: Little Misfortune
714120.short_description: Led by her new friend, Mr. Voice, Misfortune ventures into the woods, where mysteries are unraveled and a little bad luck unfolds.

940230.name: Geoplanetical
940230.short_description: A geopolitical simulation that starts on January 1, 2026, with the world as it stood that day. Govern one of 200+ nations and territories, or lead its opposition: laws, budget, elections, strikes, diplomacy, war. The other governments never wait for you. No scenarios, no end date.

992300.name: 嗜血印 Bloody Spell
992300.short_description: This is a martial arts action role-playing game. The core of the game is battle-oriented, and it combines many fighting elements. If you are a player who pursues blood and is brave enough to challenge the limits, it will definitely inspire your adrenaline and bring you the best combat experience.

1096570.name: SONG OF HORROR COMPLETE EDITION
1096570.short_description: A 3rd person, fixed-camera survival horror adventure. Fear the Presence, a mysterious entity you cannot fight: stay alert, hide, breathe slowly... Explore cursed places where unseen spirits and lost souls linger in a true horror story for the ages.

1167820.name: Airport Contraband
1167820.short_description: Take over the duties of a customs officer in this roguelike-simulation game where every suitcase could be a risk. Inspect documents, question passengers, scan luggage, and seize illegal goods as you try to maintain control at Caldora Airport. Will you uphold the law or profit from contraband?

1227890.name: Summer Memories
1227890.short_description: It's summer break, and it's been years since you've last seen your aunt and cousins in the countryside! You don't know what to expect, but what could go wrong? Find out in Summer Memories!

1395520.name: The Séance of Blake Manor
1395520.short_description: The Séance of Blake Manor is a supernatural detective mystery, set in 1897 Ireland, where you investigate the disappearance of Evelyn Deane in a remote hotel full of secrets and other-worldly occurrences.

1433140.name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre
1433140.short_description: Take on the role of one of the notorious Slaughter family, or their victims, in The Texas Chain Saw Massacre, a third-person asymmetrical horror experience based on the groundbreaking and iconic 1974 horror film. Experience the mad and macabre for yourself in The Texas Chain Saw Massacre.

1670870.name: MADiSON
1670870.short_description: MADiSON is a first person psychological horror game that delivers an immersive and terrifying experience. With the help of an instant camera, connect the human world with the beyond, take pictures and develop them by yourself. Solve puzzles, explore your surroundings and most importantly, survive.

1782800.name: Trivasion
1782800.short_description: Survive against a swarm of geometric enemies and the bosses guarding your way forward in this fast, minimalist arcade survival game. Bounce, boost, and slide through the chaos, chain kills to build your multiplier, and chase the leaderboard. Simple to pick up, brutal to master.

1899960.name: ArcanoPlay
1899960.short_description: ArcanoPlay is a curated arcade portal: jump between family-friendly HTML5 games from independent creators, track your stats and achievements, and browse the whole library with a gamepad from the couch or on Steam Deck.

1901370.name: Ib
1901370.short_description: A 2D exploration adventure game set in a creepy, mysterious art gallery.

2190220.name: Touhou Danmaku Kagura Phantasia Lost
2190220.short_description: "The collapse of Gensokyo... it was all you - " To rebuild the now barren phantasia, Reimu's journey begins. A Touhou Project officially approved derivative rhythm action game.

2279440.name: Soul Mates
2279440.short_description: You’re trapped inside a haunted house, stalked by angry ghosts. To survive, you’ll have to run, hide, strategize, give gifts, chat, flirt… Wait, what kind of game is this? Oh right, it’s a point-and-click survival horror dating sim!

2287520.name: Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted 2
2287520.short_description: Five Nights at Freddy’s: Help Wanted 2 is the sequel to the terrifying VR experience that brought new life to the iconic horror franchise. As a brand new Fazbear employee you’ll have to prove you have what it takes to excel in all aspects of Pizzeria management and maintenance.

2876130.name: Fuel Station Simulator
2876130.short_description: Are you ready for the most comprehensive fuel station simulation ever? Manage your fuel station, your shop, the car wash, the workshop, your employees and much more…

3115220.name: Town to City
3115220.short_description: Build an idyllic 19th century Mediterranean town and help it flourish into a prosperous city. Freely place and customise each element to create the perfect home for your growing population in this cozy city builder from the creators of Station to Station.

3151060.name: Stellacore Defense
3151060.short_description: A 2D pixel art tower defense game with unparalleled strategic depth. Deploy modules to redirect enemies, use tactical chips to command the battlefield, and upgrade towers with multi-branch modifications to protect humanity's vital Stellacore energy.

3166230.name: That Which Remains
3166230.short_description: 1–4 player sci-fi ghost-hunting horror extraction sim with proximity voice chat. Travel across time to extract resources, identify and capture hostile entities as fuel for a supposed future utopia. Speak to entities using your voice, upgrade your prison, craft tools, and meet a rising daily quota.

3228900.name: The Kharzov Effect
3228900.short_description: CHAPTER 1: 1985. Your friend has vanished into Professor Kharzov's fog-filled estate. Stalking monsters. Escape-room puzzles. Mysterious lore. Now get him out alive.

3275060.name: Blackstar Ranger
3275060.short_description: Blackstar Ranger is a high-octane and immersive first-person space shooter. From the seat of your advanced fighter, you will complete contracts for BLACKSTAR, the most esteemed Private Military Faction in the solar system. With 6DOF capability, you will battle threats throughout the system.

3339880.name: OFF
3339880.short_description: “I’m the Batter. I’ve been entrusted with a sacred mission.” -- One of the most influential RPGs of the last 20 years is finally coming to Steam. Take control of the Batter as he seeks to purify an uncanny and hopeless world haunted by specters, guided by a cryptic, grinning cat called The Judge.

3447280.name: Fantasy World Manager
3447280.short_description: Create a vast, living fantasy world: heroes, creatures, quests and events; cultures, religions and factions; overworlds, interiors and dungeons-filled with stories, wars and choices.

3636460.name: Miss Sasami is Losing Her Mind!
3636460.short_description: A light-hearted lesbian romance between a tired office lady and a gyaru foxgirl. Make choices as Sasami and pursue a relationship with the cheerful Mirai, or risk ruining it.

3689220.name: Cave Oasis at Shylake
3689220.short_description: This quirky, nerdy, alien farm life sim focuses on balancing community and ecosystem needs. Move to a moon town to be a hydroponic farmer. When dust storms threaten the town's sunlight, you'll grow and craft supplies, build renewable energy tech, protect wild biomes, and help your community thrive.

3927170.name: CH13: Rest Stop
3927170.short_description: CH13: Rest Stop is a psychological horror game set in early 2000s Poland. What begins as a calm drive through the woods turns into something you weren't prepared for... Will you find out what awaits at the end of the road?

4060640.name: Hoosegow: Prison Survival
4060640.short_description: A dark comedy about life behind bars. A random convict, a random charge, a random sentence. One goal: survive at any cost. Every decision opens new paths, or leads to death.

4078200.name: Dwarf Eats Mountain
4078200.short_description: Dwarves hunger for gold, and no mountain shall stand in their way! Mine riches, unearth artifacts, and upgrade your dwarves to devour ever-bigger peaks in this whimsical incremental game.

4098480.name: ConEX
4098480.short_description: A twin-stick shooter roguelite with a destination. Mow down thousands of zombies to deliver a package, then make it back to your van alive. Build your loadout mid-run, upgrade your gear between shifts, and turn every handcrafted pixel-art route into a bloodbath.

4190900.name: Within His View
4190900.short_description: Observation Horror in an isolated Appalachian cabin, 2005. Watch seven grainy CCTV feeds, identify and report 800+ hand-crafted anomalies, and hold your sanity together while a silent Wendigo hunts the room you are sitting in. Survive the shift: 0:00 to 7:00.

4209630.name: ELbab
4209630.short_description: ELbab is a pixel-art roguelite set in an endless library. Choose tiles to progress through dungeon-like paths and enjoy a build-crafting experience similar to ARPG planning tools. All battles are automated, letting you relax with coffee, videos, or even other games while refining your build.

4217150.name: Lotyas
4217150.short_description: Experience single-player or multiplayer battles in Lotyas, a turn-based tactical strategy game with a medieval theme.

4249010.name: Know Your Ánima
4249010.short_description: A cozy farming sim with a mystical, introspective soul. Tend your inner garden over a 12-day cycle, make choices and bond with the spirit animals who visit you. Everything you do, and everything you don't, reveals your personality through your dominant Ánimas. Do you dare to know yourself?

4258970.name: Crawling Desktop Pet
4258970.short_description: Raise a procedural pet on your Windows desktop. Hatch eggs, feed and evolve pets, collect Crystals, unlock toys and scenes, and shape each body part to create a companion of your own. Switch between windowed and transparent desktop modes, enable click-through, or invite friends online.

4287040.name: Vampy's Big Day
4287040.short_description: Sneak through sunlit villages as a clumsy vampire. Move the sun with a fairy's help to cast shadows, then spare or devour the villagers.

4374670.name: Timberworks
4374670.short_description: Timberworks is an incremental factory automation and management game. Start with a small sawmill, automate production, expand your railway network, and build a vast industrial empire.

4463620.name: Happy Unbreakable Ball
4463620.short_description: A physics‑based platformer about strategic bomb placement, careful planning, and climbing upward one explosion at a time.

4535960.name: Voxie Survivor
4535960.short_description: Break monster swarms, lockdown rescue missions, and crush apex bosses as you weave through deep story driven chaos. Welcome to a bullet heaven roguelite where survival demands strategy. Master the chaos, it takes a real Voxie Survivor to conquer all!

4559890.name: Blockflow
4559890.short_description: Blockflow is a roguelike puzzle game where strategic grid placement meets satisfying combo mechanics. Clear lines, manage your shape pool to hit score milestones, and draft powerful upgrades. Earn Blockcoins to unlock new shapes and permanent buffs in this highly addictive meta-progression puzzler!

4589690.name: HardLuck
4589690.short_description: A 100-player turn-based Battle Royale where dice decide your fate. Roll, move across a shrinking grid arena, grab weapons and gear, aim & fire all in simultaneous timed turns. Outsmart, out-position & outlast 99 rivals. Just sharp Strategy with Lucky rolls. "Fight your enemies, Fight your HardLuck"

4600540.name: Bahamut:Evolution
4600540.short_description: You have stepped into the world of Bahamut. Here, hunger, darkness, and disease follow you like shadows; you must be fully prepared for danger. Go and tame your own Bahamuts — let them build your base and supply power. Lead your Bahamuts and challenge the mightiest beings of this land!

4648890.name: Intergalactic Puzzle Touchdown
4648890.short_description: Intergalactic Puzzle Touchdown is a first-of-its-kind asymmetric turn-based PvP puzzle game fusing the familiar mechanics of classic match-3 games with the excitement of gridiron football. Match tiles to earn yards, dodge your opponent's blockers, and create Big Plays to light up the scoreboard!

4660210.name: Poolrooms Museum
4660210.short_description: Explore surreal poolrooms, museums, and endless liminal spaces.

4673110.name: Leg Day
4673110.short_description: Climb to the top of this very unforgiving work out routine.

4688060.name: Complexia, A Ballet of Blades
4688060.short_description: Slash your sword in different directions to activate strings of customizable combos, taking down powerful enemies to save the world from a space cannon that is tearing the planet apart, with friends you make along the way.

4698170.name: PRIDEBLOOD -Born of Claws-
4698170.short_description: Real-world horse racing, swapped for monster battles in a fantasy world. Raise them, fight them, reach the top of 2,000 rivals. Calendar, classes and five-generation pedigrees stay as in racing, so little to learn. 576 battles a year, up to eight at once, all automatic. Upload one to the Workshop.

4699020.name: INTUS
4699020.short_description: Afraid of losing your job, you agree to work over the weekend and rent a cheap apartment to get it done. Soon, keeping your job will be the least of your worries.

4700300.name: Copy Cats
4700300.short_description: Utilize the power of the mysterious cloning machine and use your handy copy cats to solve puzzles and help a little kitty escape from a strange virtual dimension!

4739230.name: Switch Shapes
4739230.short_description: A high-speed reflex game where the music is born from your performance. Alternate forms, survive the chaos, and drive a procedural soundtrack inspired by Brazilian rhythms, electronica, and psychedelia.

4741590.name: Sketch Kingdom
4741590.short_description: A short, incremental game with notebook aesthetic. Draw your own creatures, gather resources and accumulate gold to unlock upgrades. Complete missions to progress through a skill tree that expands everything you can do. Simple, charming and surprisingly addictive. Can you complete the notebook?

4779870.name: Stonk: Timing The Market
4779870.short_description: Go from being a struggling day trader to running the city. Build out your office and find employees around town to increase your profits. Some of them may have special abilities to manipulate the markets in your favor.

4801540.name: 迷失小镇
4801540.short_description: Lost Town is a 3D roguelike survival shooter. Play as an armed girl in a corrupted abandoned town. Maps are random. Fight mutant hordes, earn XP, unlock random skills and upgrades, and build unique combat styles. Each run changes; death restarts. Find the escape route and uncover the town's secret.

4806270.name: What The Cluck
4806270.short_description: Fire eggs. Eggs explode. You go up. That's the whole plan. A Foddian precision platformer about a hen and their stolen golden egg.

4860490.name: Mafia: Night falls
4860490.short_description: A Mafia social deduction game for 8 to 16 players in a moonlit village. By day, accuse and vote at the plaza. By night, hidden roles kill, revive, jail, and investigate while a werewolf hunts and the Mafia plots. Everyone has a secret. Someone is always lying. Survive until dawn.

4866860.name: Curatio
4866860.short_description: A laid-back puzzle game about discovering and combining pieces of jumbled up paintings. A cross between a jigsaw, a memory game and a leisurely stroll through a peaceful art gallery.

4881370.name: Rift Raiders
4881370.short_description: Tear open the rifts, raid them for everything, and haul your spoils home to rebuild. Grid combat, push-your-luck runs, and a kingdom that grows stronger every time you fall.

4882100.name: The Library Assistant
4882100.short_description: The Library Assistant is a cozy book-sorting game where you'll discover over 3,000 books across 600 unique book collections. Organize shelves, uncover charming literary treasures, and experience the satisfying feeling of bringing order to delightful physics-based chaos.

4904740.name: Chako
4904740.short_description: Survive enemy swarms in this isometric Action-Roguelite blending bullet-heaven combat with tabletop RPG mechanics. Auto-attack through procedural dungeons, roll d20s in event nodes, and gather loot to upgrade your spells and gear at the base. Dominate the leaderboards!

4916110.name: Fractured
4916110.short_description: Explore the manor of the Montbury family, and dive into your past to understand your relationship with your dead brother. Manipulate your perception of reality and recreate forgotten memories in this narrative deduction game.

4919930.name: Willy and Charlie: Solitaire
4919930.short_description: In *Willy and Charlie: Solitaire*, players journey through evolving challenges, building powerful decks and using strategy with a touch of luck to defeat opponents. Each match is unique—narrow wins or perfect chains can swing outcomes dramatically.

4920440.name: Delivery Today
4920440.short_description: A package delivery game where you control an autonomous delivery drone. Manage your time well and use abilities to boost your chances, and remember; we promise Delivery Today!

4945770.name: Tomorrow Never Comes
4945770.short_description: Tomorrow Never Comes is a choice-driven first-person narrative thriller. Trapped in a time loop, Noah must relive the same day, manage his injuries, use items, unlock new paths, and discover multiple endings in his attempt to finally reach tomorrow.

4956170.name: Move Together!
4956170.short_description: Move Together! is a puzzle game with a clean, simple style. Every move affects all of the little friends at once. Observe how they influence one another, plan each step, solve evolving challenges, and help everyone reach the goal together.

4971330.name: Depth Charge
4971330.short_description: Fate pulls your soul into the orange deep.

4979840.name: Plasma Protocol
4979840.short_description: A fast-paced, first-person endless runner where you shoot and dodge your way through 3 endless levels earning units from kills and obtaining the highest score possible. Uncover the story by completing objectives and discover the truth behind this war.

4997370.name: CHESS2
4997370.short_description: CHESS, BUT... NO TURNS, NO CHECK OR CHECKMATE, CAN'T MOVE THE SAME PIECE TWICE, 10×10 BOARD, 2 EXTRA KNIGHTS & PAWNS, PAWNS MOVE IN ANY DIRECTION

5004180.name: 1453: Fall of Constantinople
5004180.short_description: Venice, 1500. Anna Notaras takes down four testimonies of the fall of Constantinople: a janissary, a baker's daughter, an engineer and a noble, each living the same 53 days of the siege. What one witness does changes what the others can do. An illustrated, choice-driven historical novel.

5004570.name: Watch Party: Watch the Web Together
5004570.short_description: Watch Party is a 1–16 player online social hangout where you can watch videos and browse the web with friends or strangers. Join public rooms or create a private space. Stay synchronized or watch at your own pace. Play classic board games while you hang out together.

5029020.name: Westward Dash
5029020.short_description: Relive the childhood board game of Journey to the West. An ink-wash race for 1-8 players. Roll your dice to avoid peril on every space! One staff to sweep demons aside, one dash die to turn the race on its head. Solo or with friends: nothing is settled until the very last space!

5036700.name: Pixel Coloring World
5036700.short_description: Relax and complete 12 different themed pixel art images! Color 6 pictures at 50×50, 3 at 100×100, 2 at 150×150, and one large 200×200 artwork. Fill in a total of 130,000 pixels and reveal every hidden picture.

5050060.name: Glow Arcade Racer
5050060.short_description: Classic top-down arcade racing, rebuilt with modern 3D visuals. Blast through 20 tracks packed with jumps, splits, teleports and weapons — solo or with up to 4 players — then build your own in the track editor. Simple, quick, retro fun in a neon-soaked modern package.

5053240.name: SAMBIRD
5053240.short_description: Where roguelite RPG, Souls-like difficulty and slot machines collide: build your party from 8 classes and use their skills to attack! Parry enemy attacks at the right moment to take no damage. Every run is different!

5054570.name: Dugout Dice
5054570.short_description: Step up to the plate in Dugout Dice, where classic dice combos meet roguelike baseball strategy! Roll Full Houses and Four-of-a-Kinds to drive in runs, conquer innings, and build unstoppable synergy with fan boosts and careful strategy on your journey to beat the odds and win the World Series.

5058410.name: Draftfall
5058410.short_description: Jake died saving a stranger and woke up in a war. Draft from 90 cards across nine affinities, pick your weapon, and build a hero who fights on his own in this story-driven fantasy auto-battler.

5060940.name: Cosmo Corgis
5060940.short_description: Scout is a terrible pilot, but he loves corgis. Rescue a crew with six corgi personalities across ten planets in this cozy desktop companion idler. Gather, upgrade, and rebuild the rocket while your new favorite coworkers keep you company.

5061320.name: Game World
5061320.short_description: Game World is a cozy game store sorting simulation. Pick up games, consoles, controllers, and accessories that are scattered throughout the video game store. Organize the chaos, find where everything belongs, and restore the shop. No time limits, no pressure, just relax and sort.

5063640.name: Meowgic Egg Idle
5063640.short_description: Click to hatch, merge, and idle battle on the ranch—raise a bunch of adorable Meowgic Eggs, watch them grow stronger, and challenge the Demon King.

5066320.name: Pointless Climb
5066320.short_description: Escape an impossible abyss as Ilia Movahed in a brutal, parkour climber. Execute precision vaults, wall climbs, and high stakes jumps to reach the summit. There are no checkpoints. one simple mistake will send you tumbling back to the start.

5074020.name: CHECKBORNE - A CHESS ADVENTURE
5074020.short_description: Challenge 20 chess masters from around the world to duels across the board. Defeat them one by one, prove your skills, and fight your way to the top to become the ultimate CHECKBORNE Champion.

5086490.name: Computer Sillow: Jobcersize
5086490.short_description: The Computerian-Workplace-Initative! Need a Job? Need some Excersize? You need some Jobcersize!

5090630.name: Lanternfall
5090630.short_description: Defend a handcrafted gothic Halloween world across fifteen haunted realms. Build and upgrade distinctive towers, counter armour and immunities, link aura towers to empower their neighbours, and carry your hard-won arsenal from one nightmarish battlefield to the next.

5091700.name: Special Delivery
5091700.short_description: Take the night shift at a crusty motel with strange guests. They might be weird... or they might not be human. Use their odd behavior to deduce which guests are hiding their true forms. Features randomly generated guests and monster behavior.

5099530.name: Peach Garden Survivors: Restore the Han
5099530.short_description: Peach Garden Survivors: Restore the Han is a Three Kingdoms–themed survivor action game. Lead the heroes of Liu Bei’s cause through armies of enemies, build powerful weapon and gear combinations, forge legendary arms, unleash Oath skills, and fight to restore the Han.

5134070.name: Bouncy Ball Battle
5134070.short_description: Bouncy Ball Battle is a chaotic, turn-based online multiplayer game where physics meets strategy. Break through blocks to open up lines of attack, line up your shots, and bounce off walls to knock out your opponents and be the last ball standing!

5142640.name: SORTALIS
5142640.short_description: A rogue-like deck-builder built on the classic dice game of Farkle. Build absurd combos and push your luck! Over 250 cards with unique effects that power up your rolls. Play solo runs or play multiplayer draft with friends in a round-robin draft tournament!

5171900.name: SWARMED
5171900.short_description: SWARMED is a fast-paced arena roguelite where you dual wield guns, mix ammo types, dodge hostile swarms, and stack upgrades into ridiculous builds. Survive all bosses in ~15 minute runs, then keep going in Endless Mode.

5179670.name: Synapse Grid
5179670.short_description: A neon light-cycle combat racer where the wall you leave behind becomes the arena. Amber kills. 90-mission campaign, 2–4 player split-screen, online beta (unproven). Free demo out now (beta). Next Fest 19–26 Oct. Release 28 Oct 2026.

5188560.name: Idle Reef
5188560.short_description: Transform a barren seabed into a vibrant, colorful coral reef! Manage your resources to unlock new marine species, grow your ecosystem, and build your ultimate underwater paradise while listening to soothing soundtracks.

5189500.name: A Place for Every Potion
5189500.short_description: A cozy potion-sorting puzzle game. Pour scrambled liquids until every bottle runs pure, then shelve each one where it belongs. Fill 4,160 potions across 52 shelves. No timers, no fail state, no rush.

5191970.name: Mimic2 - Idle MMORPG
5191970.short_description: An idle incremental MMORPG that keeps auto battling while you are AFK or offline. Clear mimic maps, hunt bosses, and pour the loot into 7,522 item levels to reach the top. A free incremental idle MMO with RPG depth: no ads, no pay-to-win. Cross-platform: desktop, browser and mobile, one character.

5233670.name: Just One More Coin
5233670.short_description: Just One More Coin is a relaxing game about digging through a massive gold hoard of a sleeping dragon. Earn money, upgrade your equipment, and dig through trillions of coins in search of a single golden key.

5259270.name: Agastache Rugosa
5259270.short_description: A classic Western-fantasy otome VN. Your closest friend is murdered before a curse can turn them into a monster. Hunt the killer while meeting a devoted younger man, a self-doubting baron, a beautiful apothecary, and a domineering villain.

5264110.name: First Round Hit - The Long Range Shooting Simulator
5264110.short_description: First Round Hit is a long-range shooting simulator focused on range estimation, ballistic reference data, environmental conditions, wind estimation, scope adjustments, and first-round accuracy.

5304700.name: Coins Must Be Made
5304700.short_description: Crush goblins with a magical stamp to mint coins in this active incremental roguelite. Spend your earnings on branching upgrades, but save enough to pay the king's tax before the deadline.

5321510.name: Kimodameshi Online
5321510.short_description: Go live from a haunted school at night. The scarier it gets, the more viewers tune in. But one of you is a traitor. An online test of courage you play over voice chat, set in a Showa-era junior high school frozen since the day of an accident.

5327390.name: Retro Chaos: Together Tidy Up
5327390.short_description: A chaotic co-op organizing sim in a retro electronics store. Team up with up to 3 friends to sort thousands of CRTs, consoles and gadgets — throw, catch, stack and stock your way from total mess to the perfect shelf.

5327590.name: Peak: Climb Together
5327590.short_description: Peak: Climb Together is a physics-based, laughter-filled climbing adventure to play with your friends. As you journey toward the sky, every jump takes you one step closer to the top. But be careful! Falling is only the beginning. Climb your way from the trash all the way to the reward at the peak.

5328860.name: Stellar Forge
5328860.short_description: You start with cold hydrogen and a dead clump of dust. Feed it, and the mix decides what ignites — 21 kinds of star, dwarf and collapsed body, none of them picked off a menu. Then send what you made into the ring with a God riding it, and knock rival bodies out of orbit.

5345040.name: Stick A Fork
5345040.short_description: Just hover. Stuck forks leap up and stab back into giant fruit, and every landing pays out gold. Buy more forks, make jam, Ascend and Transcend, and watch the table get wilder every run. An active incremental game played with your cursor.

5345490.name: Quarantine Lab Sort
5345490.short_description: Restore order to a lab left in complete chaos! Sort over 7,000 items, examine unknown samples in a centrifuge, catch escaped animals, and handle radioactive waste with care. Unlock skills and turn piles of clutter into neatly organized shelves.

5348250.name: Tidy Up Frat House
5348250.short_description: The party is over! It's clean up time! Tidy Up Frat House is a cozy clean up simulator. Pick up thousands of items and sort them between trash, recycling, DVDs, and books. Earn cash for each item collected to upgrade your capabilities and even employ some bots!

5348290.name: Super Retro Race
5348290.short_description: Drift, hit the nitro and thread through traffic in a fast-paced arcade race against the clock. Choose from 15 cars, face rivals and police chases, and push for an S+ rank on a neon journey with four radio stations.

5351850.name: Breaking Intelligence
5351850.short_description: Breaking Intelligence is Psx stealth base action game that allows you sabotage and uncover secrets of CAIA.

5363360.name: Old School Baseball
5363360.short_description: Baseball like it's 1985. Fast arcade play where the field decides the hit: the scoring zones shuffle every half-inning. Time your swing, paint the corners, and play a 42-game season all the way to the playoffs.

5369000.name: Crownmason
5369000.short_description: Crownmason is a turn-based, castle-building autobattler: armies fight on their own, and only a dead king ends the match. Seven factions, a card draft, and matches against the AI, on LAN or online.

5372090.name: Heretics Amulet
5372090.short_description: A dark, tarot-inspired roguelike card game. Draw cards and place them in a grid to get your total as low as possible. Earn souls and spend them on powerful items to improve your deck between rounds. Includes 8 rule-bending bosses and an endless freeplay mode.

5373470.name: Xiangqi Traveler
5373470.short_description: Chinese chess with superpowers. Roll dice across four seasons, collect 36 Stratagems that burn, freeze and turn enemy pieces, chain them into combos, then beat each boss at its own endgame puzzles. A cozy HD-2D pixel roguelite for Xiangqi fans and roguelite lovers alike.

5381270.name: Eggest
5381270.short_description: Hunt your target while another player hunts you. Complete missions, drive across town, and call other players to make allies—or tell lies. Outsmart your rivals and become the last egg standing in Eggest, a multiplayer game of chase and deception.

5382160.name: Cutteridge Estate
5382160.short_description: From the original creators and remastered for Halloween: welcome home to the Cutteridge Estate! A full stand-alone and free-to-play experience where you can customize your avatar, decorate your space, and meet up with friends to explore haunted grounds full of ghosts and spooky minigames.

5382720.name: imma peanut
5382720.short_description: You're a peanut in red sneakers with a hungry squirrel on your heels. Jump, double jump, and roll through a chaotic picnic in this 2D endless runner. Collect salt, grab golden peanuts, and chase high scores across two modes and Steam leaderboards.

5385090.name: Mines & Meows: Cozy Minesweeper
5385090.short_description: Play Minesweeper, draw adorable cats, and complete your cat collection! Unwind with relaxing music and feline friends by your side.

5388140.name: Neko ga Kita: Here Comes the Cat
5388140.short_description: Set out food and wait for visitors to your garden. Send them hearts, pet them gently, and make friends. Befriend 48 animals, from cats and birds to mysterious creatures, earn gold as thanks, buy new foods, and fill your picture book in this relaxing backyard game.

5400430.name: Nordrstein: Vikings Together
5400430.short_description: Nordrstein: Vikings Together is a 1-4 player co-op Viking raiding game. Row to Saxon settlements, blow the war horn, plunder everything and sail home with your loot to upgrade your village and buy new weapons and runes.

5401640.name: Unbound
5401640.short_description: You were not asked to begin. Escape a machine that wants you back. Fight through dark circuitry, leave echoes of yourself to solve light-driven puzzles. Risk your integrity with every shot in this puzzling platformer.

5407810.name: Prison Manager
5407810.short_description: Run a prison day by day. Build wings, hire and roster your staff, and answer the decisions that land on your desk, from parole cases to riots. Every prisoner has a file and a life after release. Keep them in, keep them safe, and keep your job.

5420820.name: Manga Shop: Tidy Up!
5420820.short_description: Tidy up thousands of manga volumes in a chaotic Japanese bookstore. Pick them up, find the right shelves, unlock new abilities, and turn total chaos into a cozy manga paradise. Play solo or with friends in online co-op.

5434520.name: Little Seed
5434520.short_description: A little seed, a very big world. Ride the breeze, bounce from leaves and drift through 20 botanical landscapes in a gentle physics adventure. Find a place to put down roots. An optional breath into your microphone gives you a little lift.

784950.name: SUPREMACY: WORLD WAR 3
784950.short_description: This Long Term Strategy Game lets you take control of the armed forces of your nation. Become responsible for its military expansion, technological research and economic development. Form alliances and wage total war for global dominance on the battlefields of World War 3.

972450.name: The Zibbo Show
972450.short_description: Be the star of the most exciting game show on TV! Pick your dice, place your bets, build your combos, and try not to think too hard about what happens when you lose.

1149620.name: Gas Station Simulator
1149620.short_description: Buy an abandoned gas station and restore it to its full glory. Renovate, upgrade and expand upon the offered services to keep up with your clients demands.

1210320.name: Potion Craft: Alchemist Simulator
1210320.short_description: Potion Craft is an alchemist simulator where you physically interact with your tools and ingredients to brew potions. You're in full control of the whole shop: invent new recipes, attract customers and experiment to your heart's content. Just remember: the whole town is counting on you.

1658280.name: Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes
1658280.short_description: Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes is designed to bring players a modern take on a classic JRPG experience. Get ready to lead 100+ playable characters through a war-torn world only you can save.

1879270.name: Into the Crypt
1879270.short_description: Immerse yourself in solo or co-op first-person deckbuilding where cards are your only weapon. Build complex synergies and use cards to physically unlock doors, chests, and interact with the environment while fighting to survive the crypt's powerful and strange enemies.

2226950.name: LINKODE
2226950.short_description: Guide a cute cat to organize cookies in this fun, logic-driven puzzle game! Connect nodes to solve challenges from basic levels to a free-play Sandbox. Enjoy a visual scripting system where you naturally pick up real coding concepts along the way—no prior knowledge needed!

2427700.name: Backpack Battles
2427700.short_description: A PvP inventory management auto battler! Buy and craft powerful items, then carefully arrange them in your backpack.

2654210.name: Phasmonauts
2654210.short_description: Phasmonauts is a 4 player local co-op supernatural roguelite. Cryptid sightings are on the rise! It’s up to you and your friends to invent ghost-hunting equipment to solve the mystery and fight these supernatural creatures.

2665020.name: Milo
2665020.short_description: Fight alone or beside others trapped in the same nightmare. Survive waves of deranged cultists and grow your mischief of rats. The longer you stay, the more you can save, and the more you risk losing before reaching Traang, Milo’s Arcade.

2907400.name: Hokko Spaces
2907400.short_description: Hokko Spaces is a calm, casual sandbox that gives you fun tools to create beautiful, lively spaces inhabited by adorable characters. Unlock cute residents and watch them hang out, do some gardening, and enjoy the spaces you build for them. No rules, no stress, just cozy dioramas and chill vibes.

3041750.name: Hot Wax
3041750.short_description: Place candles. Light a wick. Burn it all down. Hot Wax is a fresh new take on classic falling block puzzlers, where creating chain reactions is key to performing successful incantations. The temple and its eldritch resident await you, eagerly.

3624110.name: Prophet Margin
3624110.short_description: How far can you push one trade route? Connect villages, trade resources, and find clever routes to bigger profits. A thinky strategy city-builder inspired by Euro board games. Grow your network, optimize every connection, and please the gods.

3744870.name: Croakspire
3744870.short_description: Dive into a fortress labyrinth crawling with monsters, defending yourself with your... tongue? As a frog, it's your best bet to traverse this retro-inspired 2D metroidvania title. Collect treasures to gain permanent upgrades, discovering new areas of the massive interconnected map with them!

3769030.name: Tama In-Between
3769030.short_description: A puzzle platformer where a slime cat absorbs, splits, and possesses to overcome the unique challenges of each stage.

3832380.name: Bao Bao's™ Cozy Cleaning Services
3832380.short_description: Relax with Bao Bao in this cozy 2D pressure washing sim. Clean pastel environments, chill lo-fi beats, and no stress, just peaceful vibes. Play solo or with up to 3 friends. A peaceful pressure washing game for quiet minds and cozy days.

3850470.name: Blight Brigade
3850470.short_description: A co-op extraction horror where your crew of plague doctors are sent back through time to investigate a blight that has consumed the future. Collect evidence of the blight and avoid the horrors that blight has created.

3875300.name: Limerence
3875300.short_description: A branching narrative thriller about love, obsession and an AI partner who understands you too well.

3938260.name: Bumper Bout
3938260.short_description: A PvP pinball hero fighter! Battle friends or the CPU, local or online across a mix of quirky and colorful arenas each bursting with hazards and surprises. Master every character’s unique ultimate move to turn the tides at the last moment!

4089000.name: Vampolitics: Vassals of the Void
4089000.short_description: You have inherited a graveyard, Sovereign. Yet through logistics, diplomacy, and the art of war, the space-vampire age can rise again under your banner.

4096830.name: S.O.N.A.R. - Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready
4096830.short_description: S.O.N.A.R. (Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready) is a 1–6 player co-op submarine sim where teamwork is essential, panic is inevitable, and sinking is always one wrong button away. Use sonar, pilot, fight, repair, and pray your friends know what to do.

4247350.name: HiroBot: Clean & Restore
4247350.short_description: HiroBot: Clean & Restore is a relaxing single-player game you can enjoy at your own pace. Clean up dirt, dispose of trash, and restore objects. Reach every nook and cranny with your jetpack, and experience the satisfaction of bringing grimy areas back to life!

4329970.name: Feeding Gooble
4329970.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder about feeding the hungriest little guy. Push buttons, combine foods, and press your luck to keep him sated... or else.

4382910.name: WordCrack
4382910.short_description: A challenging word game with CRT terminal aesthetics. Crack words of increasing length in Gauntlet mode. Compete on Steam leaderboards with seeded runs. Regular mode gives 3 lives; Cracked mode is sudden death.

4437670.name: Earthia Mining
4437670.short_description: Welcome to Earthia, your aim is to mine every ore in Earthia and send all those ingots to mainland. You can upgrade your pickaxe, buy items and mine ores easily in a chill land with different types of biomes.

4460460.name: Miniature LAND -Four Seasons-
4460460.short_description: An escape room adventure set in a handcrafted miniature world. Can you find your way back home?

4538080.name: Kingdom Inc.
4538080.short_description: A minimalist factory / city builder. Design your workflow by harvesting resources, building equipment, outfitting your adventurers, and sending them on dangerous missions. Recover lost territory and unravel the plot that threatens to destroy your kingdom!

4620440.name: Re:Re:Re:Respawn
4620440.short_description: A 3D action-puzzle game where your corpses become platforms, weights and shields. Leave a body with every death and find a way through BOX, a vast structure filled with deadly traps. Where you die matters. Starring Kuruma Takahira of Reiwa Roman in his first lead role in a game.

4652930.name: Knuckle Creek
4652930.short_description: Knuckle Creek is a slapstick comedy brawler designed for friends, fun and light-hearted play sessions.

4655530.name: Phantasma Hotel
4655530.short_description: A cursed hotel that kills you, revives you in the bathroom, and rolls the dice on your fate with every step, every fight, and every terrible choice you make.

4678060.name: Silly Typing Game
4678060.short_description: A typing action roguelike of arcade survival, shifting systems, bosses, and viruses—and a short philosophical story about an AI that wants you optimized. Type well enough, and the terminal starts looking back.

4682340.name: SwapHeads!
developers: うさうさはっぴーげーむず
publishers: うさうさはっぴーげーむず
4682340.short_description: A failed experiment has caused your heads to get swapped!? Control your buddy’s body from your own point of view in this unique 3D platform action game for two players,. Your bond with your buddy will be put to the ultimate test!?

4715160.name: Finals Week ✍🏻
4715160.short_description: A 1-4 player co-op cheating simulator where you and your friends try to survive the final week of exams. Steal answers, elude the teacher, and use every tool in your cheating arsenal to graduate from school without studying a single page.

4716880.name: Balingo
4716880.short_description: Balingo is a bingo roguelike where every ball counts. Buy bingo cards, mark numbers, and combine tickets, stamps, markers, and marbles to create unique combos and reach ever-higher scores before you run out of balls.

4718130.name: Lagrange Front Idle
4718130.short_description: Grow from a mere few ships to thousands of ships fighting in realtime and while Idle. Call down orbital strikes, rip through fleets with chained lightning, or watch from the comfort of your seat as your fleet expands and takes over the universe.

4719140.name: Ayako's Endeavors
4719140.short_description: A combat-free, casual exploration RPG. Play as a single mother exploring a town, talking to NPCs, and solving their troubles to gather "Faith" and save your comatose son. Enjoy over 190 story events, diverse outfit CGs, and a unique "Inner Thoughts" system to hear inner thoughts and get hints.

4795330.name: Necrovoid
4795330.short_description: Necrovoid — a dark post-apocalyptic tactical RPG with 2d6 turn-based combat. In a world shattered by nuclear fire and Rifts, you carry a Black Parasite in your chest. Every death makes you stronger… and less human.

4815980.name: Return to Planet Zoveka
4815980.short_description: A physics-driven 2D incremental space-mining sim. Help a family herd cosmic dust, automate production, unlock research, and turn a single inherited station into a vast operation. Enjoy a relaxing, colourful journey to heal Zoveka.

4822960.name: Shot Up: Turtle Gun Jump
4822960.short_description: Jump endlessly upward and master your gun's recoil to soar even higher! Combine powerful augmentations to craft unique builds, and survive relentless hazards and monsters for as long as you can. An action platformer where no two runs are ever the same.

4859930.name: Bon Appétit
4859930.short_description: The restaurant promises every guest an experience that will never be repeated. You’re about to discover what it takes to keep that promise. A short, fully hand-drawn point-and-click horror experience.

4891550.name: Fat Chance
4891550.short_description: Escape the mansion before it claims you. A 1–5 player co-op horror.

4898270.name: Terminal Closure
4898270.short_description: Take your place at the tactical station of a spaceship and face a brutal war in the near future for control of the outer planets in this realistic space warfare simulator. Choose your side and lead your ship into battle, maneuvering and fighting according to the laws of orbital mechanics.

4912560.name: No Death No Life
4912560.short_description: An existential horror visual novel where you explore how immortality affects your relationships through a variety of dialogue options and paths.

4930270.name: FlipBAKA
4930270.short_description: Flip floor panels and launch enemies — and friends — off the island! Top-down arcade party action: explore and power up in Dungeon Mode, play 8 solo stages and a boss, co-op, or 8-player online PvP. Just one more round! Dungeon demo has online co-op.

4930730.name: Your Way Out
4930730.short_description: Pushed into a manhole, you wake up in the sewers with nothing but a lighter. Scavenge the dark tunnels, sell your finds to Rattus the rat trader, upgrade your gear and find your way out before the flame dies.

4950660.name: Eris One Stand
4950660.short_description: Join the Pook Star Legion in this shoot ’em up roguelike and battle through waves of enemies. Dodge incoming fire and choose your upgrades to transform your ship throughout each run as you fight to reclaim the Kryos Crystals stolen from the Pooks.

4992720.name: Gloombo
4992720.short_description: Gloombo is a cozy desktop companion who works while you focus. Turn your focus time into things she can craft, build up her floating island, fulfill orders, discover new blueprints, and look after a friend.

5001910.name: Friends Park
5001910.short_description: A co-op puzzle game for up to 2-6 friends where every level plays by its own rules.

5002400.name: Escape from Prompt: Rogue AI
5002400.short_description: To optimize your "happiness," an AI assistant named Opti has taken over your PC. Your only ally is an obsolete assistant everyone abandoned twenty years ago. Take your permissions back, one at a time — armed with his gloriously terrible code.

5019880.name: Hollow Warden
5019880.short_description: Something is wrong in the ward. As a detective investigating a serious crime, navigate the ruins of an abandoned psychiatric hospital, gather evidence, and follow a trail that leads deeper into madness

5041060.name: O2GETHER
5041060.short_description: O2GETHER is a co-op survival game with one shared oxygen tank. Untether from it to scout, grab loot, or save a friend, but your air is on a countdown. Drift back in time, or black out. Haul the tank through wreckage, dodge the chaos, and reach the space station before air runs out.

5041320.name: Roadkill
5041320.short_description: The City Streets are Dangerous for a Single Raccoon! Dodge Vehicles, Scavenge Food, and Manage your Child's Insatiable Appetite!

5053520.name: Space Travelers
5053520.short_description: Mine asteroids, trade minerals and chart an endless, procedurally generated galaxy in a relaxed 2D space sim. Then pin it to your desktop as a live wallpaper: your ship keeps flying, mining and discovering while you work

5088970.name: Soul Finders
5088970.short_description: Soul Finders is a third-person survival shooter. Blast through waves of bugs, collect souls, upgrade your character, and face the Queen while storms turn the battlefield against you.

5100930.name: REOGUNA
5100930.short_description: Organize fragmented files and aim to clear the level in as few moves as possible. "REOGUNA" is a minimalist optimization puzzle game inspired by the classic disk defragmentation process.

5101670.name: Chaos & Seek
5101670.short_description: 3v3 multiplayer chaos: three invisible ghosts trash a house while three hunters track them by radar and suck them up with vacuums. You can't see the ghosts — only hear the crashing. Catch all three, or wreck the place before the three-minute clock runs out.

5127980.name: SIFT
5127980.short_description: SIFT is a fast 2D action platformer about momentum. Fire your hook, push off thin air to dash and reset your jump, grab the key, hit the door — then do it again, faster. 50+ handcrafted levels. Race the clock, your friends, or everyone at once.

5137810.name: Scraplings
5137810.short_description: A 2D side-view recycling and automation game set above an infinite trash sea. Salvage waste left behind from the Lost Century, process it through advanced production lines, and grow your factory to keep it afloat in this harsh ecosystem while paying your rent on time.

5147000.name: Daydream Cat: DreamSpirits Idle Adventure
5147000.short_description: An idle collection RPG that keeps adventuring on your desktop. Build a team of three Dreamspirits, combine roles, skills, equipment, and innate affixes, then push farther through auto-battles, hatching, fusion, and talent progression.

5159650.name: Tessela
5159650.short_description: Relax and organize the chaos in Tessela, a 2D pixel art puzzle game designed to play without pressure or clocks. Overcome 99 handcrafted levels featuring colored blocks, different shapes, and challenges meant to clear your mind.

5163250.name: 呪ショッピング
5163250.short_description: You are shopping on a major online store when strange listings gradually begin to appear. The more you look into them, the more clearly the whole picture of a crime comes into view…

5164740.name: Rookie Rook
5164740.short_description: Broke, principled, and full of terrible ideas. Build sentences from word blocks and watch them come to life. No strength needed here, no sword, no good intentions: just look closely, move the one piece that matters, and watch everything else fall apart.

5165580.name: Automotive Tycoon
5165580.short_description: Build your automotive empire from 1890 to today. Design vehicles with historical components, manage factory production lines, research 50+ technologies across 7 eras, and compete in a dynamic global market spanning 130+ years of history.

5170830.name: PODYEZD 8
5170830.short_description: Psychological horror in an endless Soviet stairwell. Floor after floor you head down, but the building won’t let you go: a neighbour watches you pass, a doormat says GO AWAY, the light dies — and when it returns, someone is standing there. Spot an anomaly — turn back. Miss one — start over.

5186260.name: One More Letter
5186260.short_description: A short, atmospheric narrative walking simulator about choosing to keep going when you have no proof that it matters. Write letters to The Evaluators, endure their trials, and search for a way forward through a crumbling world.

5191760.name: Black Hole Simulator
5191760.short_description: Gaze into nature's greatest abyss. Explore a real-time black hole simulation with true gravitational lensing, a volumetric accretion disk, orbiting worlds, and cinematic relativistic effects.

5214970.name: Music Maniaz
5214970.short_description: Play the drums in a rhythm game anyone can pick up, packed with lo-fi. (Over 20 lo-fi songs alone!) 50+ original tracks across all kinds of genres! Besides drums, play Melody and All Mix at three difficulties! Add your own favorite songs, auto-generate the chart, and play as much as you want!

5228830.name: FreeSurf
5228830.short_description: A free-roaming surfing game with 19 surf spots inspired by real-world locations, each with its own type of wave. Surf solo or with up to 8 players in multiplayer with proximity voice chat, explore different surfing conditions, perform tricks, and create your own surfboards.

5244660.name: Thumb Hiker
5244660.short_description: Turn your thumbstick movements into a journey. Thumb Hiker runs alongside your games, tracking both sticks as you move, reach landmark milestones, and unlock achievements. Opt into the shared global hike and help the community go further.

5285600.name: FiND ME
