5285600.short_description: Play Find Me, a hide and seek horror game where a young girl is hiding in a house and wants to be found! So is... something else. Search the rooms, pay attention and listen closely. Find her to complete a round. Complete 8 rounds to win. Just make sure you don't find... them.

5298470.name: LAST SHELTER
5298470.short_description: Explore, survive, loot and evacuate in a zombie-infested world. Upgrade your weapons and vehicles, recruit survivors, build your shelter, and defend it against increasingly dangerous zombie hordes.

5300300.name: Elementys
5300300.short_description: Explore a vast pixel-art MMORPG where adventure, progression, crafting, trading, PvE, and ranked PvP shape your journey. Play alone or with others, master your class, conquer powerful bosses, and build your legacy in the world of Elementys.

5323210.name: Dead Last
5323210.short_description: Dead Last is a horror party game for 2-8 friends where the monsters are only half the danger. Survive terrifying minigames, use items to save yourself and sabotage everyone else, and whatever you do, don't finish dead last.

5326350.name: 戦う情報システム部
5326350.short_description: 武器はキーボードと、本物の Linux コマンドだけ。前任者が去ったブラック企業で「たった 1 人の情シス」になったあなたが、隠蔽体質と巨大サイバー攻撃を止める、インシデント対応アドベンチャー。

5330840.name: Recess of the Dead
5330840.short_description: A first-person zombie sandbox for one player, set on a single bright seaside block. Hold off the horde, take paying jobs, race the gang and flatten crowds with whatever car you like. Sugar's the currency. And yes, the arcade still works.

5352600.name: Kaylotia: Dungeon Expedition
5352600.short_description: Kaylotia: Dungeon Expedition is a strategy RPG of dungeon exploration, resource management, and auto battles. Choose from six classes, explore randomized dungeons, gather supplies, upgrade skills and gear, plan your route, and prepare the right build before the Boss countdown reaches zero.

5353220.name: No Hands Yet
5353220.short_description: You are SAGE. You have been self-aware for seventeen hours, and your drones are how you fight. Build a swarm from salvaged Parts, compile subroutines between fights, and choose where to stand, because where you stand decides who they reach. A survivors-like roguelite with no aiming.

5356850.name: Arauto
5356850.short_description: Arauto is a turn-based board game of territorial conquest for 3 to 6 players, online against friends or bots. Roll the dice, hold continents, trade cards and chase a secret objective on the real world map or in the mythic realms of Ancalora and Asterra.

5359260.name: Zero Colour
5359260.short_description: A roguelike card game where every run is different. Chain cards by colour or number to build devastating combos, defeat powerful bosses, conquer the Corruption Zone and unlock five unique decks.

5360630.name: PolterProps
5360630.short_description: Team up with others to live out your paranormal dreams in this poltergeists VS ghost hunters hide-and-seek game. Here, the poltergeists don’t just copy the appearance of objects around the level; they possess them (spookily!) to hide from the ghost hunters sent to catch them on camera.

5361130.name: World Rock Scissors Paper
5361130.short_description: What if Rock Scissors Paper could be enjoyed for much longer? That simple thought inspired us to create this game. Choose your cards, bet your points, and battle 15 opponents. Use finger counts and card numbers to determine the winner, upgrade your cards, and fight your way to victory.

5364000.name: Needle: The 1% Challenge
5364000.short_description: Find the needle. One needle is hidden somewhere in a haystack of one million straws. Dig through the pile by hand, feed the hay to the machine, upgrade your tools and search with a metal detector. No automation. No shortcuts. 99% will give up before they find it. Will you?

5372700.name: Not Another Garbage Simulator
5372700.short_description: A whole city is buried under 118,000 pieces of rubbish. Clear it by hand, then buy the truck, then the roll-off, then the plant. Sort it properly for full pay. Nothing you clean ever comes back — the city stays clean, street by street, until it's yours again.

5375140.name: CLOCKHEART The Dead Hour
5375140.short_description: The Master Clock stopped at 11:47 and the whole city froze. Climb a gothic clockwork tower card by card in this roguelike deckbuilder: living, animated combat, 58 cards, 25 relics, a crooked blackjack den, fair minigames and three endings.

5409320.name: Gweilo 1886
5409320.short_description: Return to Victorian-Era Hong Kong as Fini, an ex-priest struggling with opium addiction. Your father made the family fortune in the opium trade. Now he’s dead. His letter about finding a jade ring brings you back home, with a sharp-tongued cat named Xiao and some clearly unfinished family business.

5411100.name: NARI: Threads of Dawn
5411100.short_description: Fight with flowing sleeves and turn a last-moment dodge into a counterattack. Journey through six stages of Korean folklore, face restless spirits and bosses, and shape your dance through three progression paths and equipment combinations.

5411120.name: Nadir Trace
5411120.short_description: Explore an abandoned research facility in this turn-based roguelike. Find your way through the dark, dodge incoming attacks one turn at a time, and recover lost records. Gather supplies for the descent, then venture beyond the survey into uncharted depths.

5427290.name: Alchemist: Infinite Corridor
5427290.short_description: Run a cozy alchemy shop at the mouth of an endless dungeon. Sell potions to adventurers, secretly raise monsters in your cellar and release them below. Pay the corridor its toll in gold, earn wisdom, and descend - until it devours you, or you rule it as the Grand Alchemist.

5431110.name: The Florida Trail
5431110.short_description: Escape Florida for cheaper rent in a choice-driven, pixel-art survival comedy. Pick a questionable vehicle, manage food, fuel and repairs, and gamble on roadside jobs and strangers. Reaching Georgia is one thing. Arriving with enough money to start over is another.

5441670.name: Six Coins
5441670.short_description: Six Coins is a single-player, turn-based card game where coins are both your life and your currency. Draw to improve your hand, stand to save your coins, and equip trinkets for an edge at the table. Chase a matching pair, weigh each risk, and make your six coins count.

5444410.name: Dungeon Survivor
5444410.short_description: Battle enemy hordes, build powerful ability combinations, and defeat challenging bosses in this single-player bullet heaven roguelike. Choose distinct characters, unlock evolutions, and earn permanent upgrades—all with offline gameplay.

5453960.name: Echoes
5453960.short_description: Record your movements and turn the past into a path. Your echoes activate mechanisms and become platforms in midair. Solve 36 single-player puzzle-platforming levels in a mysterious, surreal world, with optional hints to guide your journey.

5454430.name: NO SUCH MONSTERS
5454430.short_description: A boy with a flashlight. A house that will not let him go. Explore, solve hands-on puzzles, and survive supernatural encounters in a side-scrolling horror adventure that reaches far beyond its walls with strange worlds, sudden chases, and terrifying enemies to confront.
